pets.description: It moves along the ground as if sliding. Its swift movements befuddle its foes, and it then attacks with a vine whip.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Serperior
pets.description: It can stop its opponents’ movements with just a glare. It takes in solar energy and boosts it internally.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Tepig
pets.description: It can deftly dodge its foe’s attacks while shooting fireballs from its nose. It roasts berries before it eats them.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Pignite
pets.description: When its internal fire flares up, its movements grow sharper and faster. When in trouble, it emits smoke.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Emboar
pets.description: It can throw a fire punch by setting its fists on fire with its fiery chin. It cares deeply about its friends.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Oshawott
pets.description: It fights using the scalchop on its stomach. In response to an attack, it retaliates immediately by slashing.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Dewott
pets.description: Strict training is how it learns its flowing double-scalchop technique.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Samurott
pets.description: One swing of the sword incorporated in its armor can fell an opponent. A simple glare from one of them quiets everybody.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Patrat
pets.description: Using food stored in cheek pouches, they can keep watch for days. They use their tails to communicate with others.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Watchog
pets.description: When they see an enemy, their tails stand high, and they spit the seeds of berries stored in their cheek pouches.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Lillipup
pets.description: It faces strong opponents with great courage. But, when at a disadvantage in a fight, this intelligent Pokémon flees.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Herdier
pets.description: It has black, cape-like fur that is very hard and decreases the amount of damage it receives.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Stoutland
pets.description: It rescues people stranded by blizzards in the mountains. Its shaggy fur shields it from the cold.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Purrloin
pets.description: They steal from people for fun, but their victims can’t help but forgive them. Their deceptively cute act is perfect.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Liepard
pets.description: These Pokémon vanish and appear unexpectedly. Many Trainers are drawn to their beautiful form and fur.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Pansage
pets.description: This Pokémon dwells deep in the forest. Eating a leaf from its head whisks weariness away as if by magic.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Simisage
pets.description: Ill tempered, it fights by swinging its barbed tail around wildly. The leaf growing on its head is very bitter.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Pansear
pets.description: When it is angered, the temperature of its head tuft reaches 600° F. It uses its tuft to roast berries.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Simisear
pets.description: It loves sweets because they become energy for the fire burning inside its body.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Panpour
pets.description: The water stored inside the tuft on its head is full of nutrients. Plants that receive its water grow large.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Simipour
pets.description: The tuft on its head holds water. When the level runs low, it replenishes the tuft by siphoning up water with its tail.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Munna
pets.description: Munna always float in the air. People whose dreams are eaten by them forget what the dreams had been about.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Musharna
pets.description: The mist emanating from their foreheads is packed with the dreams of people and Pokémon.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Pidove
pets.description: Each follows its Trainer’s orders as best it can, but they sometimes fail to understand complicated commands.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Tranquill
pets.description: It can return to its Trainer’s location regardless of the distance separating them.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Unfezant
pets.description: Males swing their head plumage to threaten opponents. The females’ flying abilities surpass those of the males.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Blitzle
pets.description: Its mane shines when it discharges electricity. They use their flashing manes to communicate with one another.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Zebstrika
pets.description: They have lightning-like movements. When Zebstrika run at full speed, the sound of thunder reverberates.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Roggenrola
pets.description: Its ear is hexagonal in shape. Compressed underground, its body is as hard as steel.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Boldore
pets.description: When it overflows with power, the orange crystal on its body glows. It looks for underground water in caves.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Gigalith
pets.description: Compressing the energy from its internal core lets it fire off an attack capable of blowing away a mountain.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Woobat
pets.description: Its habitat is dark forests and caves. It emits ultrasonic waves from its nose to learn about its surroundings.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Swoobat
pets.description: It emits sound waves of various frequencies from its nose, including some powerful enough to destroy rocks.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Drilbur
pets.description: It can dig through the ground at a speed of 30 mph. It could give a car running aboveground a good race.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Excadrill
pets.description: It can help in tunnel construction. Its drill has evolved into steel strong enough to bore through iron plates.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Audino
pets.description: It touches others with the feelers on its ears, using the sound of their heartbeats to tell how they are feeling.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Timburr
pets.description: It fights by swinging a piece of lumber around. It is close to evolving when it can handle the lumber without difficulty.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Gurdurr
pets.description: This Pokémon is so muscular and strongly built that even a group of wrestlers could not make it budge an inch.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Conkeldurr
pets.description: It is thought that Conkeldurr taught humans how to make concrete more than 2,000 years ago.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Tympole
pets.description: They warn others of danger by vibrating their cheeks to create a high-pitched sound.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Palpitoad
pets.description: When they vibrate the bumps on their heads, they can make waves in water or earthquake-like vibrations on land.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Seismitoad
pets.description: They shoot paralyzing liquid from their head bumps. They use vibration to hurt their opponents.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Throh
pets.description: When it tightens its belt, it becomes stronger. Wild Throh use vines to weave their own belts.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Sawk
pets.description: The sound of Sawk punching boulders and trees can be heard all the way from the mountains where they train.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Sewaddle
pets.description: Leavanny dress it in clothes they made for it when it hatched. It hides its head in its hood while it is sleeping.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Swadloon
pets.description: Forests where Swadloon live have superb foliage because the nutrients they make from fallen leaves nourish the plant life.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Leavanny
pets.description: Upon finding a small Pokémon, it weaves clothing for it from leaves, using the cutters on its arms and sticky silk.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Venipede
pets.description: Its bite injects a potent poison, enough to paralyze large bird Pokémon that try to prey on it.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Whirlipede
pets.description: Protected by a hard shell, it spins its body like a wheel and crashes furiously into its enemies.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Scolipede
pets.description: With quick movements, it chases down its foes, attacking relentlessly with its horns until it prevails.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Cottonee
pets.description: When attacked, it escapes by shooting cotton from its body. The cotton serves as a decoy to distract the attacker.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Whimsicott
pets.description: Like the wind, it can slip through any gap, no matter how small. It leaves balls of white fluff behind.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Petilil
pets.description: The leaves on its head are very bitter. Eating one of these leaves is known to refresh a tired body.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Lilligant
pets.description: Even veteran Trainers face a challenge in getting its beautiful flower to bloom. This Pokémon is popular with celebrities.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Basculin
pets.description: Red and blue Basculin get along so poorly, they’ll start fighting instantly. These Pokémon are very hostile.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Sandile
pets.description: They live buried in the sands of the desert. The sun-warmed sands prevent their body temperature from dropping.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Krokorok
pets.description: They live in groups of a few individuals. Protective membranes shield their eyes from sandstorms.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Krookodile
pets.description: They never allow prey to escape. Their jaws are so powerful, they can crush the body of an automobile.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Darumaka
pets.description: When its internal fire is burning, it cannot calm down and it runs around. When the fire diminishes, it falls asleep.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Darmanitan
pets.description: Its internal fire burns at 2,500° F, making enough power that it can destroy a dump truck with one punch.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Maractus
pets.description: It uses an up-tempo song and dance to drive away the bird Pokémon that prey on its flower seeds.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Dwebble
pets.description: This Pokémon can easily melt holes in hard rocks with a liquid secreted from its mouth.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Crustle
pets.description: Competing for territory, Crustle fight viciously. The one whose boulder is broken is the loser of the battle.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Scraggy
pets.description: Its skin has a rubbery elasticity, so it can reduce damage by defensively pulling its skin up to its neck.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Scrafty
pets.description: Groups of them beat up anything that enters their territory. Each can spit acidic liquid from its mouth.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Sigilyph
pets.description: They never vary the route they fly, because their memories of guarding an ancient city remain steadfast.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Yamask
pets.description: Each of them carries a mask that used to be its face when it was human. Sometimes they look at it and cry.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Cofagrigus
pets.description: It has been said that they swallow those who get too close and turn them into mummies. They like to eat gold nuggets.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Tirtouga
pets.description: Restored from a fossil, this Pokémon can dive to depths beyond half a mile.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Carracosta
pets.description: They can live both in the ocean and on land. A slap from one of them is enough to open a hole in the bottom of a tanker.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Archen
pets.description: Said to be an ancestor of bird Pokémon, they were unable to fly and moved about by hopping from one branch to another.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Archeops
pets.description: They are intelligent and will cooperate to catch prey. From the ground, they use a running start to take flight.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Trubbish
pets.description: Inhaling the gas they belch will make you sleep for a week. They prefer unsanitary places.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Garbodor
pets.description: It clenches opponents with its left arm and finishes them off with foul-smelling poison gas belched from its mouth.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Zorua
pets.description: It changes into the forms of others to surprise them. Apparently, it often transforms into a silent child.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Zoroark
pets.description: Bonds between these Pokémon are very strong. It protects the safety of its pack by tricking its opponents.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Minccino
pets.description: They greet one another by rubbing each other with their tails, which are always kept well groomed and clean.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Cinccino
pets.description: Their white fur is coated in a special oil that makes it easy for them to deflect attacks.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Gothita
pets.description: Their ribbonlike feelers increase their psychic power. They are always staring at something.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Gothorita
pets.description: They use hypnosis to control people and Pokémon. Tales of Gothorita leading people astray are told in every corner.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Gothitelle
pets.description: Starry skies thousands of light-years away are visible in the space distorted by their intense psychic power.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Solosis
pets.description: They drive away attackers by unleashing psychic power. They can use telepathy to talk with others.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Duosion
pets.description: Since they have two divided brains, at times they suddenly try to take two different actions at once.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Reuniclus
pets.description: When Reuniclus shake hands, a network forms between their brains, increasing their psychic power.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Ducklett
pets.description: These bird Pokémon are excellent divers. They swim around in the water eating their favorite food--peat moss.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Swanna
pets.description: Swanna start to dance at dusk. The one dancing in the middle is the leader of the flock.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Vanillite
pets.description: The temperature of their breath is -58° F. They create snow crystals and make snow fall in the areas around them.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Vanillish
pets.description: Snowy mountains are this Pokémon’s habitat. During an ancient ice age, they moved to southern areas.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Vanilluxe
pets.description: Swallowing large amounts of water, they make snow clouds inside their bodies and attack their foes with violent blizzards.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Deerling
pets.description: The color and scent of their fur changes to match the mountain grass. When they sense hostility, they hide in the grass.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Sawsbuck
pets.description: They migrate according to the seasons. People can tell the season by looking at Sawsbuck’s horns.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Emolga
pets.description: The energy made in its cheeks’ electric pouches is stored inside its membrane and released while it is gliding.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Karrablast
pets.description: These mysterious Pokémon evolve when they receive electrical stimulation while they are in the same place as Shelmet.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Escavalier
pets.description: They fly around at high speed, striking with their pointed spears. Even when in trouble, they face opponents bravely.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Foongus
pets.description: It lures people in with its Poké Ball pattern, then releases poison spores. Why it resembles a Poké Ball is unknown.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Amoonguss
pets.description: It lures prey close by dancing and waving its arm caps, which resemble Poké Balls, in a swaying motion.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Frillish
pets.description: With its thin, veil-like arms wrapped around the body of its opponent, it sinks to the ocean floor.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Jellicent
pets.description: The fate of the ships and crew that wander into Jellicent’s habitat: all sunken, all lost, all vanished.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Alomomola
pets.description: The special membrane enveloping Alomomola has the ability to heal wounds.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Joltik
pets.description: Joltik that live in cities have learned a technique for sucking electricity from the outlets in houses.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Galvantula
pets.description: When attacked, they create an electric barrier by spitting out many electrically charged threads.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Ferroseed
pets.description: When threatened, it attacks by shooting a barrage of spikes, which gives it a chance to escape by rolling away.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Ferrothorn
pets.description: It fights by swinging around its three spiky feelers. A hit from these steel spikes can reduce a boulder to rubble.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Klink
pets.description: The two minigears that mesh together are predetermined. Each will rebound from other minigears without meshing.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Klang
pets.description: By changing the direction in which it rotates, it communicates its feelings to others. When angry, it rotates faster.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Klinklang
pets.description: The gear with the red core is rotated at high speed for a rapid energy charge.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Tynamo
pets.description: While one alone doesn’t have much power, a chain of many Tynamo can be as powerful as lightning.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Eelektrik
pets.description: They coil around foes and shock them with electricity-generating organs that seem simply to be circular patterns.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Eelektross
pets.description: They crawl out of the ocean using their arms. They will attack prey on shore and immediately drag it into the ocean.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Elgyem
pets.description: It uses its strong psychic power to squeeze its opponent’s brain, causing unendurable headaches.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Beheeyem
pets.description: It can manipulate an opponent’s memory. Apparently, it communicates by flashing its three different-colored fingers.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Litwick
pets.description: Litwick shines a light that absorbs the life energy of people and Pokémon, which becomes the fuel that it burns.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Lampent
pets.description: This ominous Pokémon is feared. Through cities it wanders, searching for the spirits of the fallen.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Chandelure
pets.description: It absorbs a spirit, which it then burns. By waving the flames on its arms, it puts its foes into a hypnotic trance.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Axew
pets.description: They use their tusks to crush the berries they eat. Repeated regrowth makes their tusks strong and sharp.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Fraxure
pets.description: Since a broken tusk will not grow back, they diligently sharpen their tusks on river rocks after they’ve been fighting.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Haxorus
pets.description: They are kind but can be relentless when defending territory. They challenge foes with tusks that can cut steel.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Cubchoo
pets.description: When it is not feeling well, its mucus gets watery and the power of its Ice-type moves decreases.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Beartic
pets.description: It can make its breath freeze at will. Very able in the water, it swims around in northern seas and catches prey.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Cryogonal
pets.description: When its body temperature goes up, it turns into steam and vanishes. When its temperature lowers, it returns to ice.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Shelmet
pets.description: When attacked, it defends itself by closing the lid of its shell. It can spit a sticky, poisonous liquid.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Accelgor
pets.description: When its body dries out, it weakens. So, to prevent dehydration, it wraps itself in many layers of thin membrane.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Stunfisk
pets.description: Its skin is very hard, so it is unhurt even if stepped on by sumo wrestlers. It smiles when transmitting electricity.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Mienfoo
pets.description: In fights, they dominate with onslaughts of flowing, continuous attacks. With their sharp claws, they cut enemies.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Mienshao
pets.description: It wields the fur on its arms like a whip. Its arm attacks come with such rapidity that they cannot even be seen.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Druddigon
pets.description: It warms its body by absorbing sunlight with its wings. When its body temperature falls, it can no longer move.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Golett
pets.description: The energy that burns inside it enables it to move, but no one has yet been able to identify this energy.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Golurk
pets.description: It flies across the sky at Mach speeds. Removing the seal on its chest makes its internal energy go out of control.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Pawniard
pets.description: Blades comprise this Pokémon’s entire body. If battling dulls the blades, it sharpens them on stones by the river.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Bisharp
pets.description: It leads a group of Pawniard. It battles to become the boss, but will be driven from the group if it loses.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Bouffalant
pets.description: Their fluffy fur absorbs damage, even if they strike foes with a fierce headbutt.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Rufflet
pets.description: They crush berries with their talons. They bravely stand up to any opponent, no matter how strong it is.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Braviary
pets.description: They fight for their friends without any thought about danger to themselves. One can carry a car while flying.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Vullaby
pets.description: Its wings are too tiny to allow it to fly. As the time approaches for it to evolve, it discards the bones it was wearing.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Mandibuzz
pets.description: It makes a nest out of bones it finds. It grabs weakened prey in its talons and hauls it to its nest of bones.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Heatmor
pets.description: It breathes through a hole in its tail while it burns with an internal fire. Durant is its prey.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Durant
pets.description: They attack in groups, covering themselves in steel armor to protect themselves from Heatmor.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Deino
pets.description: It tends to bite everything, and it is not a picky eater. Approaching it carelessly is dangerous.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Zweilous
pets.description: After it has eaten up all the food in its territory, it moves to another area. Its two heads do not get along.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Hydreigon
pets.description: This brutal Pokémon travels the skies on its six wings. Anything that moves seems like a foe to it, triggering its attack.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Larvesta
pets.description: This Pokémon was believed to have been born from the sun. When it evolves, its entire body is engulfed in flames.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Volcarona
pets.description: When volcanic ash darkened the atmosphere, it is said that Volcarona’s fire provided a replacement for the sun.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Cobalion
pets.description: This legendary Pokémon battled against humans to protect Pokémon. Its personality is calm and composed.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Terrakion
pets.description: This Pokémon came to the defense of Pokémon that had lost their homes in a war among humans.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Virizion
pets.description: This Pokémon fought humans in order to protect its friends. Legends about it continue to be passed down.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Tornadus
pets.description: The lower half of its body is wrapped in a cloud of energy. It zooms through the sky at 200 mph.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Thundurus
pets.description: Countless charred remains mar the landscape of places through which Thundurus has passed.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Reshiram
pets.description: This Pokémon appears in legends. It sends flames into the air from its tail, burning up everything around it.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Zekrom
pets.description: Concealing itself in lightning clouds, it flies throughout the Unova region. It creates electricity in its tail.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Landorus
pets.description: Lands visited by Landorus grant such bountiful crops that it has been hailed as “The Guardian of the Fields.”
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Kyurem
pets.description: It generates a powerful, freezing energy inside itself, but its body became frozen when the energy leaked out.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Keldeo
pets.description: By blasting water from its hooves, it can glide across water. It excels at using leg moves while battling.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Meloetta
pets.description: Its melodies are sung with a special vocalization method that can control the feelings of those who hear it.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Genesect
pets.description: Over 300 million years ago, it was feared as the strongest of hunters. It has been modified by Team Plasma.

pets.name: Bulbasaur (3D)
pets.description: For some time after its birth, it grows by gaining nourishment from the seed on its back.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Ivysaur (3D)
pets.description: When the bud on its back starts swelling, a sweet aroma wafts to indicate the flower’s coming bloom.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Venusaur (3D)
pets.description: After a rainy day, the flower on its back smells stronger. The scent attracts other Pokémon.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Charmander (3D)
pets.description: The fire on the tip of its tail is a measure of its life. If healthy, its tail burns intensely.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Charmeleon (3D)
pets.description: In the rocky mountains where Charmeleon live, their fiery tails shine at night like stars.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Charizard (3D)
pets.description: It is said that Charizard’s fire burns hotter if it has experienced harsh battles.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Squirtle (3D)
pets.description: It shelters itself in its shell, then strikes back with spouts of water at every opportunity.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Wartortle (3D)
pets.description: It is said to live 10,000 years. Its furry tail is popular as a symbol of longevity.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Blastoise (3D)
pets.description: The jets of water it spouts from the rocket cannons on its shell can punch through thick steel.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Caterpie (3D)
pets.description: It releases a stench from its red antenna to repel enemies. It grows by molting repeatedly.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Metapod (3D)
pets.description: A steel-hard shell protects its tender body. It quietly endures hardships while awaiting evolution.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Butterfree (3D)
pets.description: It loves the honey of flowers and can locate flower patches that have even tiny amounts of pollen.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Weedle (3D)
pets.description: It eats its weight in leaves every day. It fends off attackers with the needle on its head.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Kakuna (3D)
pets.description: While awaiting evolution, it hides from predators under leaves and in nooks of branches.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Beedrill (3D)
pets.description: Its best attack involves flying around at high speed, striking with poison needles, then flying off.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Pidgey (3D)
pets.description: It is docile and prefers to avoid conflict. If disturbed, however, it can ferociously strike back.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Pidgeotto (3D)
pets.description: It flies over its wide territory in search of prey, downing it with its highly developed claws.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Pidgeot (3D)
pets.description: By flapping its wings with all its might, Pidgeot can make a gust of wind capable of bending tall trees.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Rattata (3D)
pets.description: Cautious in the extreme, its hardy vitality lets it live in any kind of environment.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Raticate (3D)
pets.description: It whittles its constantly growing fangs by gnawing on hard things. It can chew apart cinder walls.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Spearow (3D)
pets.description: It flaps its small wings busily to fly. Using its beak, it searches in grass for prey.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Fearow (3D)
pets.description: It has the stamina to fly all day on its broad wings. It fights by using its sharp beak.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Ekans (3D)
pets.description: It sneaks through grass without making a sound and strikes unsuspecting prey from behind.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Arbok (3D)
pets.description: The pattern on its belly is for intimidation. It constricts foes while they are frozen in fear.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Pikachu (3D)
pets.description: It occasionally uses an electric shock to recharge a fellow Pikachu that is in a weakened state.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Raichu (3D)
pets.description: Its tail discharges electricity into the ground, protecting it from getting shocked.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Sandshrew (3D)
pets.description: To protect itself from attackers, it curls up into a ball. It lives in arid regions with minimal rainfall.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Sandslash (3D)
pets.description: It curls up, then rolls into foes with its back. Its sharp spines inflict severe damage.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Nidoran♀ (3D)
pets.description: While it does not prefer to fight, even one drop of the poison it secretes from barbs can be fatal.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Nidorina (3D)
pets.description: When it senses danger, it raises all the barbs on its body. These barbs grow slower than Nidorino’s.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Nidoqueen (3D)
pets.description: Its entire body is armored with hard scales. It will protect the young in its burrow with its life.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Nidoran♂ (3D)
pets.description: It scans its surroundings by raising its ears out of the grass. Its toxic horn is for protection.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Nidorino (3D)
pets.description: It has a violent disposition and stabs foes with its horn, which oozes poison upon impact.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Nidoking (3D)
pets.description: One swing of its mighty tail can snap a telephone pole as if it were a matchstick.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Clefairy (3D)
pets.description: It is said that happiness will come to those who see a gathering of Clefairy dancing under a full moon.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Clefable (3D)
pets.description: It is very wary and rarely shows itself to people. Its ears can hear a pin drop over half a mile away.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Vulpix (3D)
pets.description: It controls balls of fire. As it grows, its six tails split from their tips to make more tails.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Ninetales (3D)
pets.description: Its nine tails are said to be imbued with a mystic power. It can live for a thousand years.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Jigglypuff (3D)
pets.description: When it wavers its big, round eyes, it begins singing a lullaby that makes everyone drowsy.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Wigglytuff (3D)
pets.description: Its fine fur feels sublime to the touch. It can expand its body by inhaling air.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Zubat (3D)
pets.description: It checks its surroundings and location using reflections of the ultrasonic waves from its mouth.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Golbat (3D)
pets.description: Its sharp fangs puncture the toughest of hides and have small holes for greedily sucking blood.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Oddish (3D)
pets.description: It often plants its root feet in the ground during the day and sows seeds as it walks about at night.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Gloom (3D)
pets.description: The honey it drools from its mouth smells so atrocious, it can curl noses more than a mile away.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Vileplume (3D)
pets.description: Its petals are the largest in the world. As it walks, it scatters extremely allergenic pollen.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Paras (3D)
pets.description: Mushrooms named tochukaso grow on its back. They grow along with the host Paras.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Parasect (3D)
pets.description: A mushroom grown larger than the host’s body controls Parasect. It scatters poisonous spores.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Venonat (3D)
pets.description: Its big eyes are actually clusters of tiny eyes. At night, its kind is drawn by light.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Venomoth (3D)
pets.description: It flutters its wings to scatter dustlike scales. The scales leach toxins if they contact skin.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Diglett (3D)
pets.description: A Pokémon that lives underground. Because of its dark habitat, it is repelled by bright sunlight.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Dugtrio (3D)
pets.description: Its three heads move alternately, driving it through tough soil to depths of over 60 miles.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Meowth (3D)
pets.description: It is nocturnal in nature. If it spots something shiny, its eyes glitter brightly.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Persian (3D)
pets.description: A very haughty Pokémon. Among fans, the size of the jewel in its forehead is a topic of much talk.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Psyduck (3D)
pets.description: Overwhelmed by enigmatic abilities, it suffers a constant headache. It sometimes uses mysterious powers.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Golduck (3D)
pets.description: It is seen swimming dynamically and elegantly using its well-developed limbs and flippers.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Mankey (3D)
pets.description: It lives in treetop colonies. If one becomes enraged, the whole colony rampages for no reason.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Primeape (3D)
pets.description: It grows angry if you see its eyes and gets angrier if you run. If you beat it, it gets even madder.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Growlithe (3D)
pets.description: A Pokémon with a loyal nature. It will remain motionless until it is given an order by its Trainer.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Arcanine (3D)
pets.description: Its proud and regal appearance has captured the hearts of people since long ago.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Poliwag (3D)
pets.description: Its skin is so thin, its internal organs are visible. It has trouble walking on its newly grown feet.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Poliwhirl (3D)
pets.description: The spiral pattern on its belly subtly undulates. Staring at it gradually causes drowsiness.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Poliwrath (3D)
pets.description: With its extremely tough muscles, it can keep swimming in the Pacific Ocean without resting.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Abra (3D)
pets.description: Using its psychic power is such a strain on its brain that it needs to sleep for 18 hours a day.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Kadabra (3D)
pets.description: It stares at its silver spoon to focus its mind. It emits more alpha waves while doing so.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Alakazam (3D)
pets.description: The spoons clutched in its hands are said to have been created by its psychic powers.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Machop (3D)
pets.description: Though small in stature, it is powerful enough to easily heft and throw a number of Geodude at once.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Machoke (3D)
pets.description: It happily carries heavy cargo to toughen up. It willingly does hard work for people.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Machamp (3D)
pets.description: Its four muscled arms slam foes with powerful punches and chops at blinding speed.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Bellsprout (3D)
pets.description: It prefers hot and humid environments. It is quick at capturing prey with its vines.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Weepinbell (3D)
pets.description: A Pokémon that appears to be a plant. It captures unwary prey by dousing them with a toxic powder.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Victreebel (3D)
pets.description: It pools in its mouth a fluid with a honeylike scent, which is really an acid that dissolves anything.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Tentacool (3D)
pets.description: Because its body is almost entirely composed of water, it shrivels up if it is washed ashore.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Tentacruel (3D)
pets.description: It extends its 80 tentacles to form an encircling poisonous net that is difficult to escape.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Geodude (3D)
pets.description: At rest, it looks just like a rock. Carelessly stepping on it will make it swing its fists angrily.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Graveler (3D)
pets.description: It rolls on mountain paths to move. Once it builds momentum, no Pokémon can stop it without difficulty.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Golem (3D)
pets.description: Even dynamite can’t harm its hard, boulderlike body. It sheds its hide just once a year.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Ponyta (3D)
pets.description: As a newborn, it can barely stand. However, through galloping, its legs are made tougher and faster.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Rapidash (3D)
pets.description: When at an all-out gallop, its blazing mane sparkles, enhancing its beautiful appearance.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Slowpoke (3D)
pets.description: Although slow, it is skilled at fishing with its tail. It does not feel pain if its tail is bitten.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Slowbro (3D)
pets.description: Though usually dim witted, it seems to become inspired if the Shellder on its tail bites down.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Magnemite (3D)
pets.description: The faster the units at its sides rotate, the greater the magnetic force they generate.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Magneton (3D)
pets.description: Many mysteriously appear when more sunspots dot the sun. They stop TV sets from displaying properly.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Farfetch'd (3D)
pets.description: It can’t live without the stalk it holds. That’s why it defends the stalk from attackers with its life.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Doduo (3D)
pets.description: The brains in its two heads appear to communicate emotions to each other with a telepathic power.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Dodrio (3D)
pets.description: When Doduo evolves into this odd breed, one of its heads splits into two. It runs at nearly 40 mph.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Seel (3D)
pets.description: A Pokémon that lives on icebergs. It swims in the sea using the point on its head to break up ice.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Dewgong (3D)
pets.description: In snow, the pure white coat covering its body obscures it from predators.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Grimer (3D)
pets.description: It was born when sludge in a dirty stream was exposed to the moon’s X-rays. It appears among filth.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Muk (3D)
pets.description: A toxic fluid seeps from its body. The fluid instantly kills plants and trees on contact.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Shellder (3D)
pets.description: It swims backward by opening and closing its two shells. Its large tongue is always kept hanging out.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Cloyster (3D)
pets.description: It fights by keeping its shell tightly shut for protection and by shooting spikes to repel foes.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Gastly (3D)
pets.description: Born from gases, anyone would faint if engulfed by its gaseous body, which contains poison.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Haunter (3D)
pets.description: It likes to lurk in the dark and tap shoulders with a gaseous hand. Its touch causes endless shuddering.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Gengar (3D)
pets.description: The leer that floats in darkness belongs to a Gengar delighting in casting curses on people.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Onix (3D)
pets.description: It burrows through the ground at a speed of 50 mph while feeding on large boulders.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Drowzee (3D)
pets.description: It can tell what people are dreaming by sniffing with its big nose. It loves fun dreams.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Hypno (3D)
pets.description: Seeing its swinging pendulum can induce sleep in three seconds, even in someone who just woke up.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Krabby (3D)
pets.description: It lives in burrows dug on sandy beaches. Its pincers fully grow back if they are broken in battle.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Kingler (3D)
pets.description: The larger pincer has 10,000- horsepower strength. However, it is so heavy, it is difficult to aim.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Voltorb (3D)
pets.description: It looks just like a Poké Ball. It is dangerous because it may electrocute or explode on touch.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Electrode (3D)
pets.description: It is known to drift on winds if it is bloated to bursting with stored electricity.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Exeggcute (3D)
pets.description: Its six eggs converse using telepathy. They can quickly gather if they become separated.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Exeggutor (3D)
pets.description: It is called “The Walking Jungle.” If a head grows too big, it falls off and becomes an Exeggcute.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Cubone (3D)
pets.description: When it thinks of its dead mother, it cries. Its crying makes the skull it wears rattle hollowly.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Marowak (3D)
pets.description: From its birth, this savage Pokémon constantly holds bones. It is skilled in using them as weapons.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Hitmonlee (3D)
pets.description: Its legs can stretch double. First-time foes are startled by its extensible reach.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Hitmonchan (3D)
pets.description: The arm-twisting punches it throws pulverize even concrete. It rests after three minutes of fighting.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Lickitung (3D)
pets.description: When it extends its over-six-foot- long tongue, its tail quivers. There is a possibility they are connected.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Koffing (3D)
pets.description: Lighter-than-air gases in its body keep it aloft. The gases not only smell, they are also explosive.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Weezing (3D)
pets.description: It grows by feeding on gases released by garbage. Though very rare, triplets have been found.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Rhyhorn (3D)
pets.description: Its powerful tackles can destroy anything. However, it is too slow witted to help people work.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Rhydon (3D)
pets.description: Standing on its hind legs freed its forelegs and made it smarter. It is very forgetful, however.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Chansey (3D)
pets.description: A kindly Pokémon that lays highly nutritious eggs and shares them with injured Pokémon or people.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Tangela (3D)
pets.description: The blue vines shrouding its body are covered in a growth of fine hair. It is known to be ticklish.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Kangaskhan (3D)
pets.description: It raises its offspring in its belly pouch. It lets the baby out to play only when it feels safe.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Horsea (3D)
pets.description: It makes its nest in the shade of corals. If it senses danger, it spits murky ink and flees.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Seadra (3D)
pets.description: Its spines provide protection. Its fins and bones are prized as traditional medicine ingredients.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Goldeen (3D)
pets.description: Though it appears very elegant when swimming with fins unfurled, it can jab powerfully with its horn.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Seaking (3D)
pets.description: In autumn, its body becomes more fatty in preparing to propose to a mate. It takes on beautiful colors.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Staryu (3D)
pets.description: If its body is torn, it can grow back if the red core remains. The core flashes at midnight.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Starmie (3D)
pets.description: At the center of its body is a red core, which sends mysterious radio signals into the night sky.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Mr. Mime (3D)
pets.description: It shapes an invisible wall in midair by minutely vibrating its fingertips to stop molecules in the air.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Scyther (3D)
pets.description: The sharp scythes on its forearms become increasingly sharp by cutting through hard objects.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Jynx (3D)
pets.description: Its cries sound like human speech. However, it is impossible to tell what it is trying to say.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Electabuzz (3D)
pets.description: It windmills its arms to slightly boost its punches. Foes have been known to escape in the meantime.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Magmar (3D)
pets.description: When it breathes deeply, heat waves form around its body, making it hard to see clearly.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Pinsir (3D)
pets.description: It grips prey with its pincers until the prey is torn in half. What it can’t tear, it tosses far.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Tauros (3D)
pets.description: Once it takes aim at its foe, it makes a headlong charge. It is famous for its violent nature.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Magikarp (3D)
pets.description: A Magikarp living for many years can leap a mountain using Splash. The move remains useless, though.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Gyarados (3D)
pets.description: Once it begins to rampage, a Gyarados will burn everything down, even in a harsh storm.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Lapras (3D)
pets.description: It loves crossing the sea with people and Pokémon on its back. It understands human speech.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Ditto (3D)
pets.description: It has the ability to reconstitute its entire cellular structure to transform into whatever it sees.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Eevee (3D)
pets.description: Because its genetic makeup is irregular, it quickly changes its form due to a variety of causes.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Vaporeon (3D)
pets.description: Its cell composition is similar to water molecules. As a result, it can melt away into water.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Jolteon (3D)
pets.description: If agitated, it uses electricity to straighten out its fur and launch it in small bunches.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Flareon (3D)
pets.description: Inhaled air is heated in the flame sac in its body to an intense fire over 3,000 degrees Fahrenheit.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Porygon (3D)
pets.description: A man-made Pokémon created using advanced scientific means. It can move freely in cyberspace.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Omanyte (3D)
pets.description: A Pokémon that was resurrected from a fossil using modern science. It swam in ancient seas.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Omastar (3D)
pets.description: It is thought that this Pokémon became extinct because its spiral shell grew too large.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Kabuto (3D)
pets.description: It is thought to have inhabited beaches 300 million years ago. It is protected by a stiff shell.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Kabutops (3D)
pets.description: It is thought that this Pokémon came onto land because its prey adapted to life on land.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Aerodactyl (3D)
pets.description: A Pokémon that roamed the skies in the dinosaur era. Its teeth are like saw blades.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Snorlax (3D)
pets.description: When its belly is full, it becomes too lethargic to even lift a finger, so it is safe to bounce on its belly.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Articuno (3D)
pets.description: A legendary bird Pokémon. It can create blizzards by freezing moisture in the air.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Zapdos (3D)
pets.description: A legendary Pokémon that is said to live in thunderclouds. It freely controls lightning bolts.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Moltres (3D)
pets.description: One of the legendary bird Pokémon. It is said that its appearance indicates the coming of spring.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Dratini (3D)
pets.description: It is called the “Mirage Pokémon” because so few have seen it. Its shed skin has been found.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Dragonair (3D)
pets.description: If its body takes on an aura, the weather changes instantly. It is said to live in seas and lakes.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Dragonite (3D)
pets.description: It is said to make its home somewhere in the sea. It guides crews of shipwrecks to shore.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Mewtwo (3D)
pets.description: A Pokémon created by recombining Mew’s genes. It’s said to have the most savage heart among Pokémon.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Mew (3D)
pets.description: Because it can use all kinds of moves, many scientists believe Mew to be the ancestor of Pokémon.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Chikorita (3D)
pets.description: It uses the leaf on its head to determine the temperature and humidity. It loves to sunbathe.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Bayleef (3D)
pets.description: The buds that ring its neck give off a spicy aroma that perks people up.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Meganium (3D)
pets.description: Its breath has the fantastic ability to revive dead plants and flowers.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Cyndaquil (3D)
pets.description: It has a timid nature. If it is startled, the flames on its back burn more vigorously.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Quilava (3D)
pets.description: It intimidates foes with the heat of its flames. The fire burns more strongly when it readies to fight.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Typhlosion (3D)
pets.description: It attacks using blasts of fire. It creates heat shimmers with intense fire to hide itself.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Totodile (3D)
pets.description: It has the habit of biting anything with its developed jaws. Even its Trainer needs to be careful.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Croconaw (3D)
pets.description: Once it bites down, it won’t let go until it loses its fangs. New fangs quickly grow into place.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Feraligatr (3D)
pets.description: It usually moves slowly, but it goes at blinding speed when it attacks and bites prey.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Sentret (3D)
pets.description: It has a very nervous nature. It stands up high on its tail so it can scan wide areas.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Furret (3D)
pets.description: The mother puts its offspring to sleep by curling up around them. It corners foes with speed.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Hoothoot (3D)
pets.description: It marks time precisely. Some countries consider it to be a wise friend, versed in the world’s ways.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Noctowl (3D)
pets.description: Its eyes are specially developed to enable it to see clearly even in murky darkness and minimal light.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Ledyba (3D)
pets.description: It is so timid, it can’t move if it isn’t with a swarm of others. It conveys its feelings with scent.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Ledian (3D)
pets.description: It uses starlight as energy. When more stars appear at night, the patterns on its back grow larger.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Spinarak (3D)
pets.description: It sets a trap by spinning a web with thin but strong silk. It waits motionlessly for prey to arrive.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Ariados (3D)
pets.description: It attaches silk to its prey and sets it free. Later, it tracks the silk to the prey and its friends.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Crobat (3D)
pets.description: The transformation of its legs into wings made it better at flying, but more clumsy at walking.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Chinchou (3D)
pets.description: It discharges positive and negative electricity from its antenna tips to shock its foes.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Lanturn (3D)
pets.description: Lanturn’s light can shine up from great depths. It is nicknamed “The Deep-Sea Star.”
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Pichu (3D)
pets.description: The electric sacs in its cheeks are small. If even a little electricity leaks, it becomes shocked.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Cleffa (3D)
pets.description: It is often seen when shooting stars fill the night skies. It’s said to arrive riding on a shooting star.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Igglybuff (3D)
pets.description: It has a soft and bouncy body. Once it starts bouncing, it becomes impossible to stop.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Togepi (3D)
pets.description: It transforms the kindness and joy of others into happiness, which it stores in its shell.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Togetic (3D)
pets.description: To share its happiness, it flies around the world seeking kind- hearted people.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Natu (3D)
pets.description: It picks food from cactus plants, deftly avoiding buds and spines. It seems to skip about to move.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Xatu (3D)
pets.description: This odd Pokémon can see both the past and the future. It eyes the sun’s movement all day.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Mareep (3D)
pets.description: Its fluffy coat swells to double when static electricity builds up. Touching it can be shocking.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Flaaffy (3D)
pets.description: If its coat becomes fully charged with electricity, its tail lights up. It fires hair that zaps on impact.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Ampharos (3D)
pets.description: The tip of its tail shines brightly. In the olden days, people sent signals using the tail’s light.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Bellossom (3D)
pets.description: When the heavy rainfall season ends, it is drawn out by warm sunlight to dance in the open.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Marill (3D)
pets.description: The oil-filled end of its tail floats on water. It keeps Marill from drowning even in a strong current.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Azumarill (3D)
pets.description: It can spend all day in water, since it can inhale and store a large volume of air.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Sudowoodo (3D)
pets.description: To avoid being attacked, it does nothing but mimic a tree. It hates water and flees from rain.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Politoed (3D)
pets.description: It gathers groups of others as their leader. Its cries make Poliwag obey.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Hoppip (3D)
pets.description: It drifts on winds. It is said that when Hoppip gather in fields and mountains, spring is on the way.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Skiploom (3D)
pets.description: It blooms when the weather warms. It floats in the sky to soak up as much sunlight as possible.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Jumpluff (3D)
pets.description: Blown by seasonal winds, it circles the globe, scattering cotton spores as it goes.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Aipom (3D)
pets.description: It lives high among the treetops. It can use its tail as freely and cleverly as its hands.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Sunkern (3D)
pets.description: It suddenly falls out of the sky in the morning. A year after a cold summer, their population explodes.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Sunflora (3D)
pets.description: It gets energy from warm sunlight and is known for its habit of moving in pursuit of it.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Yanma (3D)
pets.description: It can hover in one spot by flapping its wings at high speed. It flits about to guard its territory.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Wooper (3D)
pets.description: When walking on land, it covers its body with a poisonous film that keeps its skin from dehydrating.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Quagsire (3D)
pets.description: It has an easygoing nature. It doesn’t care if it bumps its head on boats and boulders while swimming.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Espeon (3D)
pets.description: Its fur is so sensitive, it can sense minute shifts in the air and predict the weather.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Umbreon (3D)
pets.description: When exposed to the moon’s aura, the rings on its body glow faintly and it gains a mysterious power.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Murkrow (3D)
pets.description: If spotted, it will lure an unwary person into chasing it, then lose the pursuer on mountain trails.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Slowking (3D)
pets.description: Being bitten by Shellder gave it intelligence comparable to that of award-winning scientists.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Misdreavus (3D)
pets.description: A Pokémon that startles people in the middle of the night. It gathers fear as its energy.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Unown (3D)
pets.description: When alone, nothing happens. However, if there are two or more, an odd power is said to emerge.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Wobbuffet (3D)
pets.description: It desperately tries to keep its black tail hidden. It is said to be proof the tail hides a secret.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Girafarig (3D)
pets.description: The head on its tail contains a small brain. It can instinctively fight even while facing backward.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Pineco (3D)
pets.description: It looks just like a pinecone. Its shell protects it from bird Pokémon that peck it by mistake.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Forretress (3D)
pets.description: It is encased in a steel shell. Its peering eyes are all that can be seen of its mysterious innards.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Dunsparce (3D)
pets.description: It digs into the ground with its tail and makes a mazelike nest. It can fly just a little.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Gligar (3D)
pets.description: It glides as if sliding. It startles foes by clamping on to their faces, then jabs with its poison stinger.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Steelix (3D)
pets.description: It is thought its body transformed as a result of iron accumulating internally from swallowing soil.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Snubbull (3D)
pets.description: Small Pokémon flee from its scary face. It is, however, considered by women to be cute.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Granbull (3D)
pets.description: It is timid in spite of its looks. If it becomes enraged, however, it will strike with its huge fangs.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Qwilfish (3D)
pets.description: It shoots the poison spines on its body in all directions. Its round form makes it a poor swimmer.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Scizor (3D)
pets.description: It raises its pincers with eyelike markings for intimidation. It also swings them down dangerously.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Shuckle (3D)
pets.description: It stores berries in its shell. The berries eventually ferment to become delicious juices.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Heracross (3D)
pets.description: It loves sweet honey. To keep all the honey to itself, it hurls rivals away with its prized horn.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Sneasel (3D)
pets.description: A smart and sneaky Pokémon. A pair may work together to steal eggs by having one lure the parents away.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Teddiursa (3D)
pets.description: It lets honey soak into its paws so it can lick them all the time. Every set of paws tastes unique.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Ursaring (3D)
pets.description: In its territory, it leaves scratches on trees that bear delicious berries or fruits.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Slugma (3D)
pets.description: Its body is made of magma. If it doesn’t keep moving, its body will cool and harden.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Magcargo (3D)
pets.description: Its body temperature is roughly 18,000 degrees F. Flames spout from gaps in its hardened shell.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Swinub (3D)
pets.description: It has a very sensitive nose. It can locate mushrooms, berries, and even hot springs buried under ice.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Piloswine (3D)
pets.description: Covered by a shaggy coat, it is strong against the cold. Its tusks of ice thicken when it snows.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Corsola (3D)
pets.description: Many live in the clean seas of the south. They apparently can’t live in polluted waters.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Remoraid (3D)
pets.description: It forcefully squirts water. The water jet never misses prey even if the Remoraid is deep in the sea.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Octillery (3D)
pets.description: It loves to lurk inside holes in rocks. It sometimes sprays ink on prey by sticking out only its mouth.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Delibird (3D)
pets.description: It carries food rolled up in its tail. It has the habit of sharing food with people lost in mountains.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Mantine (3D)
pets.description: While elegantly swimming in the sea, it ignores Remoraid that cling to its fins seeking food scraps.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Skarmory (3D)
pets.description: Despite being clad entirely in iron-hard armor, it flies at speeds over 180 mph.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Houndour (3D)
pets.description: It is smart enough to hunt in packs. It uses a variety of cries for communicating with others.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Houndoom (3D)
pets.description: The flames it breathes when angry contain toxins. If they cause a burn, it will hurt forever.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Kingdra (3D)
pets.description: It lives in caves on the seafloor and creates giant whirlpools every time it moves.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Phanpy (3D)
pets.description: It is strong despite its compact size. It can easily pick up and carry an adult human on its back.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Donphan (3D)
pets.description: It attacks by curling up, then rolling into its foe. It can blow apart a house in one hit.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Porygon2 (3D)
pets.description: It was upgraded to enable the exploration of other planets. However, it failed to measure up.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Stantler (3D)
pets.description: Staring at its antlers creates an odd sensation as if one were being drawn into their centers.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Smeargle (3D)
pets.description: It marks its territory by using its tail like a paintbrush. There are more than 5,000 different marks.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Tyrogue (3D)
pets.description: It is famous for its eagerness to fight and always nurses injuries from challenging larger foes.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Hitmontop (3D)
pets.description: It fights while spinning like a top. The centrifugal force boosts its destructive power by ten.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Smoochum (3D)
pets.description: It tests everything by touching with its lips, which remember what it likes and dislikes.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Elekid (3D)
pets.description: A weak electric current flows between its horns. Sticking a hand there shocks the unwary.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Magby (3D)
pets.description: Its magma-like blood circulates throughout its body. Its body’s heat can top 1,100 degrees F.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Miltank (3D)
pets.description: It is said that kids who drink Miltank’s milk grow up to become hearty, healthy adults.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Blissey (3D)
pets.description: The eggs it lays are filled with happiness. Eating even one bite will bring a smile to anyone.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Raikou (3D)
pets.description: It is said to have fallen with lightning. It can fire thunderbolts from the rain clouds on its back.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Entei (3D)
pets.description: It is said that when it roars, a volcano erupts somewhere around the globe.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Suicune (3D)
pets.description: It races around the world to purify fouled water. It dashes away with the north wind.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Larvitar (3D)
pets.description: A Pokémon that eats soil. Once it has eaten a large mountain, it goes to sleep so it can grow.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Pupitar (3D)
pets.description: Its body is as hard as bedrock. By venting pressurized gas, it can launch itself like a rocket.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Tyranitar (3D)
pets.description: If it rampages, it knocks down mountains and buries rivers. Maps must be redrawn afterward.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Lugia (3D)
pets.description: It sleeps in a deep-sea trench. If it flaps its wings, it is said to cause a 40-day storm.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Ho-Oh (3D)
pets.description: Its feathers are in seven colors. It is said that anyone seeing it is promised eternal happiness.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Celebi (3D)
pets.description: It has the power to travel across time, but it is said to appear only in peaceful times.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Treecko (3D)
pets.description: The soles of its feet are covered by countless tiny spikes, enabling it to walk on walls and ceilings.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Grovyle (3D)
pets.description: It lives in dense jungles. While closing in on its prey, it leaps from branch to branch.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Sceptile (3D)
pets.description: The leaves that grow on its arms can slice down thick trees. It is without peer in jungle combat.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Torchic (3D)
pets.description: A fire burns inside, so it feels very warm to hug. It launches fireballs of 1,800 degrees F.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Combusken (3D)
pets.description: Its kicking mastery lets it loose 10 kicks per second. It emits sharp cries to intimidate foes.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Blaziken (3D)
pets.description: Flames spout from its wrists, enveloping its knuckles. Its punches scorch its foes.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Mudkip (3D)
pets.description: To alert it, the fin on its head senses the flow of water. It has the strength to heft boulders.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Marshtomp (3D)
pets.description: Its sturdy legs give it sure footing, even in mud. It burrows into dirt to sleep.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Swampert (3D)
pets.description: It can swim while towing a large ship. It bashes down foes with a swing of its thick arms.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Poochyena (3D)
pets.description: A Pokémon with a persistent nature, it chases its chosen prey until the prey becomes exhausted.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Mightyena (3D)
pets.description: It chases down prey in a pack. It will never disobey the commands of a skilled Trainer.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Zigzagoon (3D)
pets.description: It walks in zigzag fashion. It is good at finding items in the grass and even in the ground.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Linoone (3D)
pets.description: It charges prey at speeds over 60 mph. However, because it can only run straight, it often fails.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Wurmple (3D)
pets.description: Often targeted by bird Pokémon, it desperately resists by releasing poison from its tail spikes.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Silcoon (3D)
pets.description: It wraps silk around the branches of a tree. It drinks rainwater on its silk while awaiting evolution.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Beautifly (3D)
pets.description: Despite its looks, it is aggressive. It jabs with its long, thin mouth if disturbed while collecting pollen.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Cascoon (3D)
pets.description: It never forgets any attack it endured while in the cocoon. After evolution, it seeks payback.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Dustox (3D)
pets.description: Toxic powder is scattered with each flap. At night, it is known to strip leaves off trees lining boulevards.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Lotad (3D)
pets.description: It looks like an aquatic plant and serves as a ferry to Pokémon that can’t swim.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Lombre (3D)
pets.description: It has a mischievous spirit. If it spots an angler, it will tug on the fishing line to interfere.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Ludicolo (3D)
pets.description: If it hears festive music, all its muscles fill with energy. It can’t help breaking out into a dance.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Seedot (3D)
pets.description: When it dangles from a tree branch, it looks just like an acorn. It enjoys scaring other Pokémon.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Nuzleaf (3D)
pets.description: The sound of its grass flute makes its listeners uneasy. It lives deep in forests.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Shiftry (3D)
pets.description: By flapping its leafy fan, it can whip up gusts of 100 ft/second that can level houses.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Taillow (3D)
pets.description: It has a gutsy spirit that makes it bravely take on tough foes. It flies in search of warm climates.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Swellow (3D)
pets.description: It circles the sky in search of prey. When it spots one, it dives steeply to catch the prey.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Wingull (3D)
pets.description: It soars high in the sky, riding on updrafts like a glider. It carries food tucked in its bill.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Pelipper (3D)
pets.description: It is a messenger of the skies, carrying small Pokémon and eggs to safety in its bill.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Ralts (3D)
pets.description: If its horns capture the warm feelings of people or Pokémon, its body warms up slightly.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Kirlia (3D)
pets.description: If its Trainer becomes happy, it overflows with energy, dancing joyously while spinning about.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Gardevoir (3D)
pets.description: To protect its Trainer, it will expend all its psychic power to create a small black hole.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Surskit (3D)
pets.description: It appears as if it is skating on water. It draws prey with a sweet scent from the tip of its head.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Masquerain (3D)
pets.description: Its antennae have eye patterns on them. Its four wings enable it to hover and fly in any direction.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Shroomish (3D)
pets.description: It spouts poison spores from the top of its head. These spores cause pain all over if inhaled.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Breloom (3D)
pets.description: Its short arms stretch when it throws punches. Its technique is equal to that of pro boxers.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Slakoth (3D)
pets.description: It spends nearly all its time in a day sprawled out. Just seeing it makes one drowsy.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Vigoroth (3D)
pets.description: Its heart beats at a tenfold tempo, so it cannot sit still for even a moment.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Slaking (3D)
pets.description: The world’s laziest Pokémon. When it is lounging, it is actually saving energy for striking back.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Nincada (3D)
pets.description: It grows underground, sensing its surroundings using antennae instead of its virtually blind eyes.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Ninjask (3D)
pets.description: Because it moves so quickly, it sometimes becomes unseeable. It congregates around tree sap.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Shedinja (3D)
pets.description: A discarded bug shell that came to life. Peering into the crack on its back is said to steal one’s spirit.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Whismur (3D)
pets.description: Usually, its cries are like quiet murmurs. If frightened, it shrieks at the same volume as a jet plane.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Loudred (3D)
pets.description: The shock waves from its cries can tip over trucks. It stamps its feet to power up.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Exploud (3D)
pets.description: Its howls can be heard over six miles away. It emits all sorts of noises from the ports on its body.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Makuhita (3D)
pets.description: It toughens its body by slamming into thick trees. Many snapped trees can be found near its nest.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Hariyama (3D)
pets.description: It loves to match power with big-bodied Pokémon. It can knock a truck flying with its arm thrusts.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Azurill (3D)
pets.description: Its tail bounces like a rubber ball. It flings that tail around to fight opponents bigger than itself.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Nosepass (3D)
pets.description: When endangered, it may protect itself by raising its magnetism and drawing iron objects to its body.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Skitty (3D)
pets.description: It can’t stop itself from chasing moving things, and it runs in a circle, chasing its own tail.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Delcatty (3D)
pets.description: It is highly popular among female Trainers for its sublime fur. It does not keep a nest.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Sableye (3D)
pets.description: It hides in the darkness of caves. Its diet of gems has transformed its eyes into gemstones.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Mawile (3D)
pets.description: Attached to its head is a huge set of jaws formed by horns. It can chew through iron beams.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Aron (3D)
pets.description: It usually lives deep in mountains. However, hunger may drive it to eat railroad tracks and cars.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Lairon (3D)
pets.description: For food, it digs up iron ore. It smashes its steely body against others to fight over territory.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Aggron (3D)
pets.description: While seeking iron for food, it digs tunnels by breaking through bedrock with its steel horns.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Meditite (3D)
pets.description: It always trains deep in mountains. It levitates when it heightens its spiritual power through meditation.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Medicham (3D)
pets.description: It gains the ability to see the aura of its opponents by honing its mind through starvation.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Electrike (3D)
pets.description: Using electricity stored in its fur, it stimulates its muscles to heighten its reaction speed.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Manectric (3D)
pets.description: It discharges electricity from its mane. It creates a thundercloud overhead to drop lightning bolts.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Plusle (3D)
pets.description: It cheers on friends with pom-poms made of sparks. It drains power from telephone poles.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Minun (3D)
pets.description: It cheers on friends. If its friends are losing, its body lets off more and more sparks.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Volbeat (3D)
pets.description: It communicates with others by lighting up its rear at night. It loves Illumise’s sweet aroma.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Illumise (3D)
pets.description: With its sweet aroma, it guides Volbeat to draw signs with light in the night sky.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Roselia (3D)
pets.description: The more healthy the Roselia, the more pleasant its flowers’ aroma. Its scent deeply relaxes people.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Gulpin (3D)
pets.description: Almost all its body is its stomach. Its harsh digestive juices quickly dissolve anything it swallows.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Swalot (3D)
pets.description: It swallows anything whole. It sweats toxic fluids from its follicles to douse foes.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Carvanha (3D)
pets.description: They swarm any foe that invades their territory. Their sharp fangs can tear out boat hulls.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Sharpedo (3D)
pets.description: Its fangs rip through sheet iron. It swims at 75 mph and is known as “The Bully of the Sea.”
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Wailmer (3D)
pets.description: On sunny days, it lands on beaches to bounce like a ball and play. It spouts water from its nose.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Wailord (3D)
pets.description: The biggest of all Pokémon. It can dive to a depth of almost 10,000 feet on only one breath.
pets.author: codex-pokepets
