pets.name: Numel (3D)
pets.description: Its humped back stores intensely hot magma. In rain, the magma cools, slowing its movement.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Camerupt (3D)
pets.description: It has volcanoes on its back. If magma builds up in its body, it shudders, then erupts violently.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Torkoal (3D)
pets.description: It burns coal inside its shell for energy. It blows out black soot if it is endangered.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Spoink (3D)
pets.description: It bounces constantly, using its tail like a spring. The shock of bouncing keeps its heart beating.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Grumpig (3D)
pets.description: It uses black pearls to amplify its psycho-power. It does an odd dance to gain control over foes.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Spinda (3D)
pets.description: No two Spinda have the same pattern of spots. Its tottering step fouls the aim of foes.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Trapinch (3D)
pets.description: It makes a conical pit in desert sand and lies in wait at the bottom for prey to come tumbling down.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Vibrava (3D)
pets.description: It violently shudders its wings, generating ultrasonic waves to induce headaches in people.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Flygon (3D)
pets.description: It whips up sandstorms with powerful flaps of its wings. It is known as “The Desert Spirit.”
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Cacnea (3D)
pets.description: By storing water in its body, this desert dweller can survive for 30 days without water.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Cacturne (3D)
pets.description: It becomes active at night, seeking prey that is exhausted from the day’s desert heat.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Swablu (3D)
pets.description: It can’t relax if it or its surroundings are not clean. It wipes off dirt with its wings.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Altaria (3D)
pets.description: If it bonds with a person, it will gently envelop the friend with its soft wings, then hum.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Zangoose (3D)
pets.description: It has feuded with Seviper for many generations. Its sharp claws are its biggest weapons.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Seviper (3D)
pets.description: For many generations, it has feuded with Zangoose. It whets its bladed tail on rocks for battle.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Lunatone (3D)
pets.description: Because it turns active on nights of the full moon, it is said to have some link to the lunar phases.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Solrock (3D)
pets.description: Solar energy is the source of its power, so it is strong during the daytime. When it spins, its body shines.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Barboach (3D)
pets.description: Its slimy body is hard to grasp. In one region, it is said to have been born from hardened mud.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Whiscash (3D)
pets.description: It is extremely protective of its territory. If any foe approaches, it attacks using vicious tremors.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Corphish (3D)
pets.description: Its hardy vitality enables it to adapt to any environment. Its pincers will never release prey.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Crawdaunt (3D)
pets.description: It is a ruffian that uses its pincers to pick up and toss out other Pokémon from its pond.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Baltoy (3D)
pets.description: It moves by spinning on its foot. It is a rare Pokémon that was discovered in ancient ruins.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Claydol (3D)
pets.description: An ancient clay figurine that came to life as a Pokémon from exposure to a mysterious ray of light.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Lileep (3D)
pets.description: It lived on the seafloor 100 million years ago and was reanimated scientifically.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Cradily (3D)
pets.description: It lives in the shallows of warm seas. When the tide goes out, it digs up prey from beaches.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Anorith (3D)
pets.description: A Pokémon ancestor that was reanimated from a fossil. It lived in the sea and hunted with claws.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Armaldo (3D)
pets.description: It went ashore after evolving. Its entire body is clad in a sturdy armor.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Feebas (3D)
pets.description: It is a shabby and ugly Pokémon. However, it is very hardy and can survive on little water.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Milotic (3D)
pets.description: Its lovely scales are described as rainbow colored. They change color depending on the viewing angle.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Castform (3D)
pets.description: Its appearance changes with the weather. Recently, its molecules were found to be just like water.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Kecleon (3D)
pets.description: It can freely change its body’s color. The zigzag pattern on its belly doesn’t change, however.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Shuppet (3D)
pets.description: It loves vengeful emotions and hangs in rows under the eaves of houses where vengeful people live.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Banette (3D)
pets.description: A doll that became a Pokémon over its grudge from being junked. It seeks the child that disowned it.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Duskull (3D)
pets.description: It loves the crying of children. It startles bad kids by passing through walls and making them cry.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Dusclops (3D)
pets.description: It seeks drifting will-o’-the-wisps and sucks them into its empty body. What happens inside is a mystery.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Tropius (3D)
pets.description: Delicious fruits grew out from around its neck because it always ate the same kind of fruit.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Chimecho (3D)
pets.description: Its cries echo inside its hollow body to emerge as beautiful notes for startling and repelling foes.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Absol (3D)
pets.description: Rumored to sense disasters with its horn, it became a target. It fled deep into the mountains.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Wynaut (3D)
pets.description: It grows strong by pushing up against others en masse. It loves eating sweet fruit.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Snorunt (3D)
pets.description: It is said that several Snorunt gather under giant leaves and live together in harmony.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Glalie (3D)
pets.description: It prevents prey from escaping by instantaneously freezing moisture in the air.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Spheal (3D)
pets.description: It rolls across ice floes to reach shore because its body is poorly shaped for swimming.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Sealeo (3D)
pets.description: It habitually spins things on its nose. By doing so, it learns textures and odors.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Walrein (3D)
pets.description: It shatters ice with its big tusks. Its thick blubber repels not only the cold, but also enemy attacks.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Clamperl (3D)
pets.description: It makes a single pearl during its lifetime. The pearl is said to amplify psychic power.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Huntail (3D)
pets.description: It lives deep in the sea. With a tail shaped like a small fish, it attracts unsuspecting prey.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Gorebyss (3D)
pets.description: It lives at the bottom of the sea. In the springtime, its pink body turns more vivid for some reason.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Relicanth (3D)
pets.description: A rare Pokémon discovered during a deep-sea exploration. It has not changed in over 100 million years.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Luvdisc (3D)
pets.description: It lives in warm seas. It is said that a couple finding this Pokémon will be blessed with eternal love.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Bagon (3D)
pets.description: Dreaming of one day flying, it practices by leaping off cliffs every day.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Shelgon (3D)
pets.description: Within its rugged shell, its cells have begun changing. The shell peels off the instant it evolves.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Salamence (3D)
pets.description: As a result of its long-held dream of flying, its cellular structure changed, and wings grew out.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Beldum (3D)
pets.description: It converses with others by using magnetic pulses. In a swarm, they move in perfect unison.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Metang (3D)
pets.description: It is formed by two Beldum joining together. Its steel body won’t be scratched if it collides with a jet.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Metagross (3D)
pets.description: Metang combined to form it. With four brains, it has the intelligence of a supercomputer.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Regirock (3D)
pets.description: Its entire body is made of rock. If any part chips off in battle, it attaches rocks to repair itself.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Regice (3D)
pets.description: Its body is made of ice from the ice age. It controls frigid air of -328 degrees Fahrenheit.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Registeel (3D)
pets.description: Tempered by pressure underground over tens of thousands of years, its body cannot be scratched.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Latias (3D)
pets.description: Its body is covered with a down that can refract light in such a way that it becomes invisible.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Latios (3D)
pets.description: A highly intelligent Pokémon. By folding back its wings in flight, it can overtake jet planes.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Kyogre (3D)
pets.description: It is said to have widened the seas by causing downpours. It had been asleep in a marine trench.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Groudon (3D)
pets.description: It had been asleep in underground magma ever since it fiercely fought Kyogre long ago.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Rayquaza (3D)
pets.description: It lives in the ozone layer far above the clouds and cannot be seen from the ground.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Jirachi (3D)
pets.description: It is said to have the ability to grant any wish for just one week every thousand years.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Deoxys (3D)
pets.description: An alien virus that fell to earth on a meteor underwent a DNA mutation to become this Pokémon.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Turtwig (3D)
pets.description: The shell on its back is made of soil. On a very healthy Turtwig, the shell should feel moist.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Grotle (3D)
pets.description: It knows where pure water wells up. It carries fellow Pokémon there on its back.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Torterra (3D)
pets.description: Some Pokémon are born on a Torterra’s back and spend their entire life there.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Chimchar (3D)
pets.description: It is very agile. Before going to sleep, it extinguishes the flame on its tail to prevent fires.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Monferno (3D)
pets.description: It skillfully controls the intensity of the fire on its tail to keep its foes at an ideal distance.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Infernape (3D)
pets.description: It uses unique fighting moves with fire on its hands and feet. It will take on any opponent.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Piplup (3D)
pets.description: A poor walker, it often falls down. However, its strong pride makes it puff up its chest without a care.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Prinplup (3D)
pets.description: Because every Prinplup considers itself to be the most important, they can never form a group.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Empoleon (3D)
pets.description: If anyone were to hurt its pride, it would slash them with wings that can cleave through an ice floe.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Starly (3D)
pets.description: Because they are weak individually, they form groups. However, they bicker if the group grows too big.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Staravia (3D)
pets.description: Recognizing their own weakness, they always live in a group. When alone, a Staravia cries noisily.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Staraptor (3D)
pets.description: It never stops attacking even if it is injured. It fusses over the shape of its comb.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Bidoof (3D)
pets.description: A comparison revealed that Bidoof’s front teeth grow at the same rate as Rattata’s.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Bibarel (3D)
pets.description: A river dammed by Bibarel will never overflow its banks, which is appreciated by people nearby.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Kricketot (3D)
pets.description: Its legs are short. Whenever it stumbles, its stiff antennae clack with a xylophone-like sound.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Kricketune (3D)
pets.description: There is a village that hosts a contest based on the amazingly variable cries of this Pokémon.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Shinx (3D)
pets.description: The extension and contraction of its muscles generates electricity. It glows when in trouble.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Luxio (3D)
pets.description: Strong electricity courses through the tips of its sharp claws. A light scratch causes fainting in foes.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Luxray (3D)
pets.description: It can see clearly through walls to track down its prey and seek its lost young.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Budew (3D)
pets.description: Sensitive to changing temperature, the bud is said to bloom when it feels the sun’s warm touch.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Roserade (3D)
pets.description: Each of its hands contains different toxins, but both hands can jab with near-fatal power.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Cranidos (3D)
pets.description: A lifelong jungle dweller from 100 million years ago, it would snap obstructing trees with head butts.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Rampardos (3D)
pets.description: If two were to smash their heads together, their foot-thick skulls would keep them from fainting.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Shieldon (3D)
pets.description: It is outstandingly armored. As a result, it can eat grass and berries without having to fight.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Bastiodon (3D)
pets.description: When they lined up side by side, no foe could break through. They shielded their young in that way.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Burmy (3D)
pets.description: Even if it is born where there are no cocooning materials, it somehow always ends up with a cloak.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Wormadam (3D)
pets.description: When evolving, its body takes in surrounding materials. As a result, there are many body variations.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Mothim (3D)
pets.description: While it loves floral honey, it won’t gather any itself. Instead, it plots to steal some from Combee.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Combee (3D)
pets.description: The trio is together from birth. It constantly gathers honey from flowers to please Vespiquen.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Vespiquen (3D)
pets.description: It releases various pheromones to make the grubs in its body do its bidding while fighting foes.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Pachirisu (3D)
pets.description: A pair may be seen rubbing their cheek pouches together in an effort to share stored electricity.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Buizel (3D)
pets.description: It spins its two tails like a screw to propel itself through water. The tails also slice clinging seaweed.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Floatzel (3D)
pets.description: It is a common sight around fishing ports. It is known to rescue people and carry off prey.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Cherubi (3D)
pets.description: The small ball is not only filled with nutrients, it is also tasty. Starly try to peck it off.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Cherrim (3D)
pets.description: If it senses strong sunlight, it opens its folded petals to absorb the sun’s rays with its whole body.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Shellos (3D)
pets.description: Beware of pushing strongly on its squishy body, as it makes a mysterious purple fluid ooze out.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Gastrodon (3D)
pets.description: Long ago, its entire back was shielded with a sturdy shell. There are traces of it left in its cells.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Ambipom (3D)
pets.description: Split into two, the tails are so adept at handling and doing things, Ambipom rarely uses its hands.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Drifloon (3D)
pets.description: Because of the way it floats aimlessly, an old folktale calls it a “Signpost for Wandering Spirits.”
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Drifblim (3D)
pets.description: At dusk, swarms of them are carried aloft on winds. When noticed, they suddenly vanish.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Buneary (3D)
pets.description: Its ears are always rolled up. They can be forcefully extended to shatter even a large boulder.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Lopunny (3D)
pets.description: The ears appear to be delicate. If they are touched roughly, it kicks with its graceful legs.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Mismagius (3D)
pets.description: Its cry sounds like an incantation. It is said the cry may rarely be imbued with happiness-giving power.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Honchkrow (3D)
pets.description: If one utters a deep cry, many Murkrow gather quickly. For this, it is called “Summoner of Night.”
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Glameow (3D)
pets.description: It hides its spiteful tendency of hooking its claws into the nose of its Trainer if it isn’t fed.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Purugly (3D)
pets.description: It binds its body with its tails to make itself look bigger. If it locks eyes, it will glare ceaselessly.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Chingling (3D)
pets.description: There is an orb inside its mouth. When it hops, the orb bounces all over and makes a ringing sound.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Stunky (3D)
pets.description: It sprays a foul fluid from its rear. Its stench spreads over a mile radius, driving Pokémon away.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Skuntank (3D)
pets.description: It attacks by spraying a horribly smelly fluid from the tip of its tail. Attacks from above confound it.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Bronzor (3D)
pets.description: There are researchers who believe this Pokémon reflected like a mirror in the distant past.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Bronzong (3D)
pets.description: It brought rains by opening portals to another world. It was revered as a bringer of plentiful harvests.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Bonsly (3D)
pets.description: It prefers an arid atmosphere. It leaks water that looks like tears when adjusting its moisture level.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Mime Jr. (3D)
pets.description: It mimics the expressions and motions of those it sees to understand the feelings of others.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Happiny (3D)
pets.description: It likes to carry around a small rock. It may wander around others’ feet and cause them to stumble.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Chatot (3D)
pets.description: Its tongue is just like a human’s. As a result, it can cleverly mimic human speech.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Spiritomb (3D)
pets.description: Its constant mischief and misdeeds resulted in it being bound to an Odd Keystone by a mysterious spell.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Gible (3D)
pets.description: It attacks using its huge mouth. While its attacks are powerful, it hurts itself out of clumsiness, too.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Gabite (3D)
pets.description: It loves sparkly things. It seeks treasures in caves and hoards the loot in its nest.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Garchomp (3D)
pets.description: It is said that when one runs at high speed, its wings create blades of wind that can fell nearby trees.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Munchlax (3D)
pets.description: In its desperation to gulp down food, it forgets about the food it has hidden under its fur.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Riolu (3D)
pets.description: It has the peculiar power of being able to see emotions such as joy and rage in the form of waves.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Lucario (3D)
pets.description: A well-trained one can sense auras to identify and take in the feelings of creatures over half a mile away.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Hippopotas (3D)
pets.description: It shuts its nostrils tight then travels through sand as if walking. They form colonies of around ten.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Hippowdon (3D)
pets.description: It is surprisingly quick to anger. It holds its mouth agape as a display of its strength.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Skorupi (3D)
pets.description: As soon as the tail claws close, its needle tips secrete poison. It can survive a year without food.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Drapion (3D)
pets.description: Possessing a sturdy build, it takes pride in its strength, taking down foes without using toxins.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Croagunk (3D)
pets.description: It rarely fights fairly, but that is strictly to ensure survival. It is popular as a mascot.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Toxicroak (3D)
pets.description: It has a poison sac at its throat. When it croaks, the stored poison is churned for greater potency.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Carnivine (3D)
pets.description: It binds itself to trees in marshes. It attracts prey with its sweet- smelling drool and gulps them down.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Finneon (3D)
pets.description: The line running down its side can store sunlight. It shines vividly at night.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Lumineon (3D)
pets.description: It crawls along the seafloor using its long front fins like legs. It competes for food with Lanturn.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Mantyke (3D)
pets.description: People organize tours to see this Pokémon frolic and skim the tops of waves with Remoraid.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Snover (3D)
pets.description: Seemingly curious about people, they gather around footsteps they find on snowy mountains.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Abomasnow (3D)
pets.description: They appear when the snow flowers bloom. When the petals fall, they retreat to places unknown again.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Weavile (3D)
pets.description: Evolution made it even more devious. It communicates by clawing signs in boulders.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Magnezone (3D)
pets.description: A group tried to use scientific means to make Magnezone evolve, but their efforts ended in failure.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Lickilicky (3D)
pets.description: The long tongue is always soggy with slobber. The saliva contains a solvent that causes numbness.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Rhyperior (3D)
pets.description: It can launch a rock held in its hand like a missile by tightening then expanding muscles instantly.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Tangrowth (3D)
pets.description: Its arms are made of plants that bind themselves to things. They grow back right away if cut.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Electivire (3D)
pets.description: Heedless of enemy attacks, it closes in, shoves its tails onto the foe, then looses high voltage.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Magmortar (3D)
pets.description: When launching 3,600 degrees F fireballs, its body takes on a whitish hue from the intense heat.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Togekiss (3D)
pets.description: It shares many blessings with people who respect one another’s rights and avoid needless strife.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Yanmega (3D)
pets.description: Its jaw power is incredible. It is adept at biting apart foes while flying by at high speed.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Leafeon (3D)
pets.description: It basically does not fight. With cells similar to those of plants, it can perform photosynthesis.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Glaceon (3D)
pets.description: By controlling its body heat, it can freeze the atmosphere around it to make a diamond-dust flurry.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Gliscor (3D)
pets.description: If it succeeds in catching even a faint breeze properly, it can circle the globe without flapping once.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Mamoswine (3D)
pets.description: A frozen one was dug up from soil dating back 10,000 years. It woke up to much amazement.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Porygon-Z (3D)
pets.description: Its programming was modified to enable work in alien dimensions. It did not work as planned.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Gallade (3D)
pets.description: When trying to protect someone, it extends its elbows as if they were swords and fights savagely.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Probopass (3D)
pets.description: It freely controls three small units called Mini-Noses using magnetic force.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Dusknoir (3D)
pets.description: It is said to take lost spirits into its pliant body and guide them home.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Froslass (3D)
pets.description: It freezes prey by blowing its -58 degrees F breath. It is said to then secretly display its prey.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Rotom (3D)
pets.description: Its electric-like body can enter some kinds of machines and take control in order to make mischief.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Uxie (3D)
pets.description: When Uxie flew, people gained the ability to solve problems. It was the birth of knowledge.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Mesprit (3D)
pets.description: When Mesprit flew, people learned the joy and sadness of living. It was the birth of emotions.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Azelf (3D)
pets.description: When Azelf flew, people gained the determination to do things. It was the birth of willpower.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Dialga (3D)
pets.description: A legendary Pokémon of Sinnoh. It is said that time flows when Dialga’s heart beats.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Palkia (3D)
pets.description: A legendary Pokémon of Sinnoh. It is said that space becomes more stable with Palkia’s every breath.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Heatran (3D)
pets.description: Its body is made of rugged steel. However, it is partially melted in spots because of its own heat.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Regigigas (3D)
pets.description: It is said to have made Pokémon that look like itself from a special ice mountain, rocks, and magma.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Giratina (3D)
pets.description: It was banished for its violence. It silently gazed upon the old world from the Distortion World.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Cresselia (3D)
pets.description: On nights around the quarter moon, the aurora from its tail extends and undulates beautifully.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Phione (3D)
pets.description: It drifts in warm seas. It always returns to where it was born, no matter how far it may have drifted.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Manaphy (3D)
pets.description: It is born with a wondrous power that lets it bond with any kind of Pokémon.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Darkrai (3D)
pets.description: To protect itself, it afflicts those around it with nightmares. However, it means no harm.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Shaymin (3D)
pets.description: The flowers all over its body burst into bloom if it is lovingly hugged and senses gratitude.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Arceus (3D)
pets.description: It is said to have emerged from an egg in a place where there was nothing, then shaped the world.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Victini (3D)
pets.description: This Pokémon brings victory. It is said that Trainers with Victini always win, regardless of the type of encounter.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Snivy (3D)
pets.description: It is very intelligent and calm. Being exposed to lots of sunlight makes its movements swifter.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Servine (3D)
pets.description: It moves along the ground as if sliding. Its swift movements befuddle its foes, and it then attacks with a vine whip.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Serperior (3D)
pets.description: It can stop its opponents’ movements with just a glare. It takes in solar energy and boosts it internally.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Tepig (3D)
pets.description: It can deftly dodge its foe’s attacks while shooting fireballs from its nose. It roasts berries before it eats them.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Pignite (3D)
pets.description: When its internal fire flares up, its movements grow sharper and faster. When in trouble, it emits smoke.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Emboar (3D)
pets.description: It can throw a fire punch by setting its fists on fire with its fiery chin. It cares deeply about its friends.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Oshawott (3D)
pets.description: It fights using the scalchop on its stomach. In response to an attack, it retaliates immediately by slashing.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Dewott (3D)
pets.description: Strict training is how it learns its flowing double-scalchop technique.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Samurott (3D)
pets.description: One swing of the sword incorporated in its armor can fell an opponent. A simple glare from one of them quiets everybody.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Patrat (3D)
pets.description: Using food stored in cheek pouches, they can keep watch for days. They use their tails to communicate with others.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Watchog (3D)
pets.description: When they see an enemy, their tails stand high, and they spit the seeds of berries stored in their cheek pouches.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Lillipup (3D)
pets.description: It faces strong opponents with great courage. But, when at a disadvantage in a fight, this intelligent Pokémon flees.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Herdier (3D)
pets.description: It has black, cape-like fur that is very hard and decreases the amount of damage it receives.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Stoutland (3D)
pets.description: It rescues people stranded by blizzards in the mountains. Its shaggy fur shields it from the cold.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Purrloin (3D)
pets.description: They steal from people for fun, but their victims can’t help but forgive them. Their deceptively cute act is perfect.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Liepard (3D)
pets.description: These Pokémon vanish and appear unexpectedly. Many Trainers are drawn to their beautiful form and fur.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Pansage (3D)
pets.description: This Pokémon dwells deep in the forest. Eating a leaf from its head whisks weariness away as if by magic.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Simisage (3D)
pets.description: Ill tempered, it fights by swinging its barbed tail around wildly. The leaf growing on its head is very bitter.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Pansear (3D)
pets.description: When it is angered, the temperature of its head tuft reaches 600° F. It uses its tuft to roast berries.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Simisear (3D)
pets.description: It loves sweets because they become energy for the fire burning inside its body.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Panpour (3D)
pets.description: The water stored inside the tuft on its head is full of nutrients. Plants that receive its water grow large.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Simipour (3D)
pets.description: The tuft on its head holds water. When the level runs low, it replenishes the tuft by siphoning up water with its tail.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Munna (3D)
pets.description: Munna always float in the air. People whose dreams are eaten by them forget what the dreams had been about.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Musharna (3D)
pets.description: The mist emanating from their foreheads is packed with the dreams of people and Pokémon.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Pidove (3D)
pets.description: Each follows its Trainer’s orders as best it can, but they sometimes fail to understand complicated commands.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Tranquill (3D)
pets.description: It can return to its Trainer’s location regardless of the distance separating them.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Unfezant (3D)
pets.description: Males swing their head plumage to threaten opponents. The females’ flying abilities surpass those of the males.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Blitzle (3D)
pets.description: Its mane shines when it discharges electricity. They use their flashing manes to communicate with one another.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Zebstrika (3D)
pets.description: They have lightning-like movements. When Zebstrika run at full speed, the sound of thunder reverberates.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Roggenrola (3D)
pets.description: Its ear is hexagonal in shape. Compressed underground, its body is as hard as steel.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Boldore (3D)
pets.description: When it overflows with power, the orange crystal on its body glows. It looks for underground water in caves.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Gigalith (3D)
pets.description: Compressing the energy from its internal core lets it fire off an attack capable of blowing away a mountain.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Woobat (3D)
pets.description: Its habitat is dark forests and caves. It emits ultrasonic waves from its nose to learn about its surroundings.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Swoobat (3D)
pets.description: It emits sound waves of various frequencies from its nose, including some powerful enough to destroy rocks.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Drilbur (3D)
pets.description: It can dig through the ground at a speed of 30 mph. It could give a car running aboveground a good race.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Excadrill (3D)
pets.description: It can help in tunnel construction. Its drill has evolved into steel strong enough to bore through iron plates.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Audino (3D)
pets.description: It touches others with the feelers on its ears, using the sound of their heartbeats to tell how they are feeling.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Timburr (3D)
pets.description: It fights by swinging a piece of lumber around. It is close to evolving when it can handle the lumber without difficulty.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Gurdurr (3D)
pets.description: This Pokémon is so muscular and strongly built that even a group of wrestlers could not make it budge an inch.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Conkeldurr (3D)
pets.description: It is thought that Conkeldurr taught humans how to make concrete more than 2,000 years ago.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Tympole (3D)
pets.description: They warn others of danger by vibrating their cheeks to create a high-pitched sound.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Palpitoad (3D)
pets.description: When they vibrate the bumps on their heads, they can make waves in water or earthquake-like vibrations on land.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Seismitoad (3D)
pets.description: They shoot paralyzing liquid from their head bumps. They use vibration to hurt their opponents.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Throh (3D)
pets.description: When it tightens its belt, it becomes stronger. Wild Throh use vines to weave their own belts.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Sawk (3D)
pets.description: The sound of Sawk punching boulders and trees can be heard all the way from the mountains where they train.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Sewaddle (3D)
pets.description: Leavanny dress it in clothes they made for it when it hatched. It hides its head in its hood while it is sleeping.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Swadloon (3D)
pets.description: Forests where Swadloon live have superb foliage because the nutrients they make from fallen leaves nourish the plant life.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Leavanny (3D)
pets.description: Upon finding a small Pokémon, it weaves clothing for it from leaves, using the cutters on its arms and sticky silk.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Venipede (3D)
pets.description: Its bite injects a potent poison, enough to paralyze large bird Pokémon that try to prey on it.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Whirlipede (3D)
pets.description: Protected by a hard shell, it spins its body like a wheel and crashes furiously into its enemies.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Scolipede (3D)
pets.description: With quick movements, it chases down its foes, attacking relentlessly with its horns until it prevails.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Cottonee (3D)
pets.description: When attacked, it escapes by shooting cotton from its body. The cotton serves as a decoy to distract the attacker.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Whimsicott (3D)
pets.description: Like the wind, it can slip through any gap, no matter how small. It leaves balls of white fluff behind.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Petilil (3D)
pets.description: The leaves on its head are very bitter. Eating one of these leaves is known to refresh a tired body.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Lilligant (3D)
pets.description: Even veteran Trainers face a challenge in getting its beautiful flower to bloom. This Pokémon is popular with celebrities.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Basculin (3D)
pets.description: Red and blue Basculin get along so poorly, they’ll start fighting instantly. These Pokémon are very hostile.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Sandile (3D)
pets.description: They live buried in the sands of the desert. The sun-warmed sands prevent their body temperature from dropping.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Krokorok (3D)
pets.description: They live in groups of a few individuals. Protective membranes shield their eyes from sandstorms.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Krookodile (3D)
pets.description: They never allow prey to escape. Their jaws are so powerful, they can crush the body of an automobile.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Darumaka (3D)
pets.description: When its internal fire is burning, it cannot calm down and it runs around. When the fire diminishes, it falls asleep.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Darmanitan (3D)
pets.description: Its internal fire burns at 2,500° F, making enough power that it can destroy a dump truck with one punch.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Maractus (3D)
pets.description: It uses an up-tempo song and dance to drive away the bird Pokémon that prey on its flower seeds.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Dwebble (3D)
pets.description: This Pokémon can easily melt holes in hard rocks with a liquid secreted from its mouth.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Crustle (3D)
pets.description: Competing for territory, Crustle fight viciously. The one whose boulder is broken is the loser of the battle.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Scraggy (3D)
pets.description: Its skin has a rubbery elasticity, so it can reduce damage by defensively pulling its skin up to its neck.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Scrafty (3D)
pets.description: Groups of them beat up anything that enters their territory. Each can spit acidic liquid from its mouth.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Sigilyph (3D)
pets.description: They never vary the route they fly, because their memories of guarding an ancient city remain steadfast.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Yamask (3D)
pets.description: Each of them carries a mask that used to be its face when it was human. Sometimes they look at it and cry.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Cofagrigus (3D)
pets.description: It has been said that they swallow those who get too close and turn them into mummies. They like to eat gold nuggets.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Tirtouga (3D)
pets.description: Restored from a fossil, this Pokémon can dive to depths beyond half a mile.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Carracosta (3D)
pets.description: They can live both in the ocean and on land. A slap from one of them is enough to open a hole in the bottom of a tanker.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Archen (3D)
pets.description: Said to be an ancestor of bird Pokémon, they were unable to fly and moved about by hopping from one branch to another.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Archeops (3D)
pets.description: They are intelligent and will cooperate to catch prey. From the ground, they use a running start to take flight.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Trubbish (3D)
pets.description: Inhaling the gas they belch will make you sleep for a week. They prefer unsanitary places.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Garbodor (3D)
pets.description: It clenches opponents with its left arm and finishes them off with foul-smelling poison gas belched from its mouth.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Zorua (3D)
pets.description: It changes into the forms of others to surprise them. Apparently, it often transforms into a silent child.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Zoroark (3D)
pets.description: Bonds between these Pokémon are very strong. It protects the safety of its pack by tricking its opponents.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Minccino (3D)
pets.description: They greet one another by rubbing each other with their tails, which are always kept well groomed and clean.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Cinccino (3D)
pets.description: Their white fur is coated in a special oil that makes it easy for them to deflect attacks.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Gothita (3D)
pets.description: Their ribbonlike feelers increase their psychic power. They are always staring at something.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Gothorita (3D)
pets.description: They use hypnosis to control people and Pokémon. Tales of Gothorita leading people astray are told in every corner.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Gothitelle (3D)
pets.description: Starry skies thousands of light-years away are visible in the space distorted by their intense psychic power.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Solosis (3D)
pets.description: They drive away attackers by unleashing psychic power. They can use telepathy to talk with others.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Duosion (3D)
pets.description: Since they have two divided brains, at times they suddenly try to take two different actions at once.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Reuniclus (3D)
pets.description: When Reuniclus shake hands, a network forms between their brains, increasing their psychic power.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Ducklett (3D)
pets.description: These bird Pokémon are excellent divers. They swim around in the water eating their favorite food--peat moss.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Swanna (3D)
pets.description: Swanna start to dance at dusk. The one dancing in the middle is the leader of the flock.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Vanillite (3D)
pets.description: The temperature of their breath is -58° F. They create snow crystals and make snow fall in the areas around them.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Vanillish (3D)
pets.description: Snowy mountains are this Pokémon’s habitat. During an ancient ice age, they moved to southern areas.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Vanilluxe (3D)
pets.description: Swallowing large amounts of water, they make snow clouds inside their bodies and attack their foes with violent blizzards.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Deerling (3D)
pets.description: The color and scent of their fur changes to match the mountain grass. When they sense hostility, they hide in the grass.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Sawsbuck (3D)
pets.description: They migrate according to the seasons. People can tell the season by looking at Sawsbuck’s horns.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Emolga (3D)
pets.description: The energy made in its cheeks’ electric pouches is stored inside its membrane and released while it is gliding.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Karrablast (3D)
pets.description: These mysterious Pokémon evolve when they receive electrical stimulation while they are in the same place as Shelmet.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Escavalier (3D)
pets.description: They fly around at high speed, striking with their pointed spears. Even when in trouble, they face opponents bravely.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Foongus (3D)
pets.description: It lures people in with its Poké Ball pattern, then releases poison spores. Why it resembles a Poké Ball is unknown.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Amoonguss (3D)
pets.description: It lures prey close by dancing and waving its arm caps, which resemble Poké Balls, in a swaying motion.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Frillish (3D)
pets.description: With its thin, veil-like arms wrapped around the body of its opponent, it sinks to the ocean floor.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Jellicent (3D)
pets.description: The fate of the ships and crew that wander into Jellicent’s habitat: all sunken, all lost, all vanished.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Alomomola (3D)
pets.description: The special membrane enveloping Alomomola has the ability to heal wounds.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Joltik (3D)
pets.description: Joltik that live in cities have learned a technique for sucking electricity from the outlets in houses.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Galvantula (3D)
pets.description: When attacked, they create an electric barrier by spitting out many electrically charged threads.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Ferroseed (3D)
pets.description: When threatened, it attacks by shooting a barrage of spikes, which gives it a chance to escape by rolling away.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Ferrothorn (3D)
pets.description: It fights by swinging around its three spiky feelers. A hit from these steel spikes can reduce a boulder to rubble.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Klink (3D)
pets.description: The two minigears that mesh together are predetermined. Each will rebound from other minigears without meshing.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Klang (3D)
pets.description: By changing the direction in which it rotates, it communicates its feelings to others. When angry, it rotates faster.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Klinklang (3D)
pets.description: The gear with the red core is rotated at high speed for a rapid energy charge.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Tynamo (3D)
pets.description: While one alone doesn’t have much power, a chain of many Tynamo can be as powerful as lightning.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Eelektrik (3D)
pets.description: They coil around foes and shock them with electricity-generating organs that seem simply to be circular patterns.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Eelektross (3D)
pets.description: They crawl out of the ocean using their arms. They will attack prey on shore and immediately drag it into the ocean.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Elgyem (3D)
pets.description: It uses its strong psychic power to squeeze its opponent’s brain, causing unendurable headaches.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Beheeyem (3D)
pets.description: It can manipulate an opponent’s memory. Apparently, it communicates by flashing its three different-colored fingers.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Litwick (3D)
pets.description: Litwick shines a light that absorbs the life energy of people and Pokémon, which becomes the fuel that it burns.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Lampent (3D)
pets.description: This ominous Pokémon is feared. Through cities it wanders, searching for the spirits of the fallen.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Chandelure (3D)
pets.description: It absorbs a spirit, which it then burns. By waving the flames on its arms, it puts its foes into a hypnotic trance.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Axew (3D)
pets.description: They use their tusks to crush the berries they eat. Repeated regrowth makes their tusks strong and sharp.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Fraxure (3D)
pets.description: Since a broken tusk will not grow back, they diligently sharpen their tusks on river rocks after they’ve been fighting.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Haxorus (3D)
pets.description: They are kind but can be relentless when defending territory. They challenge foes with tusks that can cut steel.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Cubchoo (3D)
pets.description: When it is not feeling well, its mucus gets watery and the power of its Ice-type moves decreases.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Beartic (3D)
pets.description: It can make its breath freeze at will. Very able in the water, it swims around in northern seas and catches prey.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Cryogonal (3D)
pets.description: When its body temperature goes up, it turns into steam and vanishes. When its temperature lowers, it returns to ice.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Shelmet (3D)
pets.description: When attacked, it defends itself by closing the lid of its shell. It can spit a sticky, poisonous liquid.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Accelgor (3D)
pets.description: When its body dries out, it weakens. So, to prevent dehydration, it wraps itself in many layers of thin membrane.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Stunfisk (3D)
pets.description: Its skin is very hard, so it is unhurt even if stepped on by sumo wrestlers. It smiles when transmitting electricity.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Mienfoo (3D)
pets.description: In fights, they dominate with onslaughts of flowing, continuous attacks. With their sharp claws, they cut enemies.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Mienshao (3D)
pets.description: It wields the fur on its arms like a whip. Its arm attacks come with such rapidity that they cannot even be seen.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Druddigon (3D)
pets.description: It warms its body by absorbing sunlight with its wings. When its body temperature falls, it can no longer move.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Golett (3D)
pets.description: The energy that burns inside it enables it to move, but no one has yet been able to identify this energy.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Golurk (3D)
pets.description: It flies across the sky at Mach speeds. Removing the seal on its chest makes its internal energy go out of control.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Pawniard (3D)
pets.description: Blades comprise this Pokémon’s entire body. If battling dulls the blades, it sharpens them on stones by the river.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Bisharp (3D)
pets.description: It leads a group of Pawniard. It battles to become the boss, but will be driven from the group if it loses.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Bouffalant (3D)
pets.description: Their fluffy fur absorbs damage, even if they strike foes with a fierce headbutt.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Rufflet (3D)
pets.description: They crush berries with their talons. They bravely stand up to any opponent, no matter how strong it is.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Braviary (3D)
pets.description: They fight for their friends without any thought about danger to themselves. One can carry a car while flying.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Vullaby (3D)
pets.description: Its wings are too tiny to allow it to fly. As the time approaches for it to evolve, it discards the bones it was wearing.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Mandibuzz (3D)
pets.description: It makes a nest out of bones it finds. It grabs weakened prey in its talons and hauls it to its nest of bones.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Heatmor (3D)
pets.description: It breathes through a hole in its tail while it burns with an internal fire. Durant is its prey.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Durant (3D)
pets.description: They attack in groups, covering themselves in steel armor to protect themselves from Heatmor.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Deino (3D)
pets.description: It tends to bite everything, and it is not a picky eater. Approaching it carelessly is dangerous.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Zweilous (3D)
pets.description: After it has eaten up all the food in its territory, it moves to another area. Its two heads do not get along.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Hydreigon (3D)
pets.description: This brutal Pokémon travels the skies on its six wings. Anything that moves seems like a foe to it, triggering its attack.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Larvesta (3D)
pets.description: This Pokémon was believed to have been born from the sun. When it evolves, its entire body is engulfed in flames.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Volcarona (3D)
pets.description: When volcanic ash darkened the atmosphere, it is said that Volcarona’s fire provided a replacement for the sun.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Cobalion (3D)
pets.description: This legendary Pokémon battled against humans to protect Pokémon. Its personality is calm and composed.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Terrakion (3D)
pets.description: This Pokémon came to the defense of Pokémon that had lost their homes in a war among humans.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Virizion (3D)
pets.description: This Pokémon fought humans in order to protect its friends. Legends about it continue to be passed down.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Tornadus (3D)
pets.description: The lower half of its body is wrapped in a cloud of energy. It zooms through the sky at 200 mph.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Thundurus (3D)
pets.description: Countless charred remains mar the landscape of places through which Thundurus has passed.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Reshiram (3D)
pets.description: This Pokémon appears in legends. It sends flames into the air from its tail, burning up everything around it.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Zekrom (3D)
pets.description: Concealing itself in lightning clouds, it flies throughout the Unova region. It creates electricity in its tail.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Landorus (3D)
pets.description: Lands visited by Landorus grant such bountiful crops that it has been hailed as “The Guardian of the Fields.”
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Kyurem (3D)
pets.description: It generates a powerful, freezing energy inside itself, but its body became frozen when the energy leaked out.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Keldeo (3D)
pets.description: By blasting water from its hooves, it can glide across water. It excels at using leg moves while battling.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Meloetta (3D)
pets.description: Its melodies are sung with a special vocalization method that can control the feelings of those who hear it.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Genesect (3D)
pets.description: Over 300 million years ago, it was feared as the strongest of hunters. It has been modified by Team Plasma.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Chespin (3D)
pets.description: The quills on its head are usually soft. When it flexes them, the points become so hard and sharp that they can pierce rock.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Quilladin (3D)
pets.description: It relies on its sturdy shell to deflect predators’ attacks. It counterattacks with its sharp quills.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Chesnaught (3D)
pets.description: Its Tackle is forceful enough to flip a 50-ton tank. It shields its allies from danger with its own body.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Fennekin (3D)
pets.description: Eating a twig fills it with energy, and its roomy ears give vent to air hotter than 390 degrees Fahrenheit.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Braixen (3D)
pets.description: It has a twig stuck in its tail. With friction from its tail fur, it sets the twig on fire and launches into battle.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Delphox (3D)
pets.description: It gazes into the flame at the tip of its branch to achieve a focused state, which allows it to see into the future.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Froakie (3D)
pets.description: It secretes flexible bubbles from its chest and back. The bubbles reduce the damage it would otherwise take when attacked.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Frogadier (3D)
pets.description: It can throw bubble-covered pebbles with precise control, hitting empty cans up to a hundred feet away.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Greninja (3D)
pets.description: It creates throwing stars out of compressed water. When it spins them and throws them at high speed, these stars can split metal in two.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Bunnelby (3D)
pets.description: They use their large ears to dig burrows. They will dig the whole night through.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Diggersby (3D)
pets.description: With their powerful ears, they can heft boulders of a ton or more with ease. They can be a big help at construction sites.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Fletchling (3D)
pets.description: These friendly Pokémon send signals to one another with beautiful chirps and tail-feather movements.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Fletchinder (3D)
pets.description: From its beak, it expels embers that set the tall grass on fire. Then it pounces on the bewildered prey that pop out of the grass.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Talonflame (3D)
pets.description: In the fever of an exciting battle, it showers embers from the gaps between its feathers and takes to the air.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Scatterbug (3D)
pets.description: When under attack from bird Pokémon, it spews a poisonous black powder that causes paralysis on contact.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Spewpa (3D)
pets.description: It lives hidden within thicket shadows. When predators attack, it quickly bristles the fur covering its body in an effort to threaten them.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Vivillon (3D)
pets.description: Vivillon with many different patterns are found all over the world. These patterns are affected by the climate of their habitat.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Litleo (3D)
pets.description: The stronger the opponent it faces, the more heat surges from its mane and the more power flows through its body.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Pyroar (3D)
pets.description: The male with the largest mane of fire is the leader of the pride.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Flabebe (3D)
pets.description: It draws out and controls the hidden power of flowers. The flower Flabébé holds is most likely part of its body.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Floette (3D)
pets.description: It flutters around fields of flowers and cares for flowers that are starting to wilt. It draws out the hidden power of flowers to battle.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Florges (3D)
pets.description: It claims exquisite flower gardens as its territory, and it obtains power from basking in the energy emitted by flowering plants.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Skiddo (3D)
pets.description: Thought to be one of the first Pokémon to live in harmony with humans, it has a placid disposition.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Gogoat (3D)
pets.description: It can tell how its Trainer is feeling by subtle shifts in the grip on its horns. This empathic sense lets them run as if one being.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Pancham (3D)
pets.description: It does its best to be taken seriously by its enemies, but its glare is not sufficiently intimidating. Chewing on a leaf is its trademark.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Pangoro (3D)
pets.description: Although it possesses a violent temperament, it won’t put up with bullying. It uses the leaf in its mouth to sense the movements of its enemies.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Furfrou (3D)
pets.description: Trimming its fluffy fur not only makes it more elegant but also increases the swiftness of its movements.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Espurr (3D)
pets.description: The organ that emits its intense psychic power is sheltered by its ears to keep power from leaking out.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Meowstic (3D)
pets.description: When in danger, it raises its ears and releases enough psychic power to grind a 10-ton truck into dust.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Honedge (3D)
pets.description: Apparently this Pokémon is born when a departed spirit inhabits a sword. It attaches itself to people and drinks their life force.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Doublade (3D)
pets.description: When Honedge evolves, it divides into two swords, which cooperate via telepathy to coordinate attacks and slash their enemies to ribbons.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Aegislash (3D)
pets.description: Generations of kings were attended by these Pokémon, which used their spectral power to manipulate and control people and Pokémon.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Spritzee (3D)
pets.description: It emits a scent that enraptures those who smell it. This fragrance changes depending on what it has eaten.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Aromatisse (3D)
pets.description: It devises various scents, pleasant and unpleasant, and emits scents that its enemies dislike in order to gain an edge in battle.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Swirlix (3D)
pets.description: To entangle its opponents in battle, it extrudes white threads as sweet and sticky as cotton candy.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Slurpuff (3D)
pets.description: It can distinguish the faintest of scents. It puts its sensitive sense of smell to use by helping pastry chefs in their work.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Inkay (3D)
pets.description: Opponents who stare at the flashing of the light-emitting spots on its body become dazed and lose their will to fight.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Malamar (3D)
pets.description: It wields the most compelling hypnotic powers of any Pokémon, and it forces others to do whatever it wants.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Binacle (3D)
pets.description: Two Binacle live together on one rock. When they fight, one of them will move to a different rock.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Barbaracle (3D)
pets.description: When they evolve, two Binacle multiply into seven. They fight with the power of seven Binacle.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Skrelp (3D)
pets.description: Camouflaged as rotten kelp, they spray liquid poison on prey that approaches unawares and then finish it off.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Dragalge (3D)
pets.description: Their poison is strong enough to eat through the hull of a tanker, and they spit it indiscriminately at anything that enters their territory.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Clauncher (3D)
pets.description: They knock down flying prey by firing compressed water from their massive claws like shooting a pistol.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Clawitzer (3D)
pets.description: Their enormous claws launch cannonballs of water powerful enough to pierce tanker hulls.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Helioptile (3D)
pets.description: They make their home in deserts. They can generate their energy from basking in the sun, so eating food is not a requirement.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Heliolisk (3D)
pets.description: They flare their frills and generate energy. A single Heliolisk can generate sufficient electricity to power a skyscraper.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Tyrunt (3D)
pets.description: This Pokémon was restored from a fossil. If something happens that it doesn’t like, it throws a tantrum and runs wild.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Tyrantrum (3D)
pets.description: Thanks to its gargantuan jaws, which could shred thick metal plates as if they were paper, it was invincible in the ancient world it once inhabited.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Amaura (3D)
pets.description: This ancient Pokémon was restored from part of its body that had been frozen in ice for over 100 million years.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Aurorus (3D)
pets.description: The diamond-shaped crystals on its body expel air as cold as -240 degrees Fahrenheit, surrounding its enemies and encasing them in ice.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Sylveon (3D)
pets.description: It sends a soothing aura from its ribbonlike feelers to calm fights.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Hawlucha (3D)
pets.description: Although its body is small, its proficient fighting skills enable it to keep up with big bruisers like Machamp and Hariyama.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Dedenne (3D)
pets.description: Its whiskers serve as antennas. By sending and receiving electrical waves, it can communicate with others over vast distances.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Carbink (3D)
pets.description: Born from the temperatures and pressures deep underground, it fires beams from the stone in its head.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Goomy (3D)
pets.description: The weakest Dragon-type Pokémon, it lives in damp, shady places, so its body doesn’t dry out.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Sliggoo (3D)
pets.description: It drives away opponents by excreting a sticky liquid that can dissolve anything. Its eyes devolved, so it can’t see anything.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Goodra (3D)
pets.description: This very friendly Dragon-type Pokémon will hug its beloved Trainer, leaving that Trainer covered in sticky slime.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Klefki (3D)
pets.description: These key collectors threaten any attackers by fiercely jingling their keys at them.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Phantump (3D)
pets.description: These Pokémon are created when spirits possess rotten tree stumps. They prefer to live in abandoned forests.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Trevenant (3D)
pets.description: It can control trees at will. It will trap people who harm the forest, so they can never leave.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Pumpkaboo (3D)
pets.description: The pumpkin body is inhabited by a spirit trapped in this world. As the sun sets, it becomes restless and active.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Gourgeist (3D)
pets.description: Singing in eerie voices, they wander town streets on the night of the new moon. Anyone who hears their song is cursed.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Bergmite (3D)
pets.description: It blocks opponents’ attacks with the ice that shields its body. It uses cold air to repair any cracks with new ice.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Avalugg (3D)
pets.description: Its ice-covered body is as hard as steel. Its cumbersome frame crushes anything that stands in its way.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Noibat (3D)
pets.description: They live in pitch-black caves. Their enormous ears can emit ultrasonic waves of 200,000 hertz.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Noivern (3D)
pets.description: They fly around on moonless nights and attack careless prey. Nothing can beat them in a battle in the dark.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Xerneas (3D)
pets.description: Legends say it can share eternal life. It slept for a thousand years in the form of a tree before its revival.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Yveltal (3D)
pets.description: When this legendary Pokémon’s wings and tail feathers spread wide and glow red, it absorbs the life force of living creatures.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Zygarde (3D)
pets.description: When the Kalos region’s ecosystem falls into disarray, it appears and reveals its secret power.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Diancie (3D)
pets.description: A sudden transformation of Carbink, its pink, glimmering body is said to be the loveliest sight in the whole world.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Hoopa (3D)
pets.description: This troublemaker sends anything and everything to faraway places using its loop, which can warp space.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Volcanion (3D)
pets.description: It lets out billows of steam and disappears into the dense fog. It’s said to live in mountains where humans do not tread.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Rowlet (3D)
pets.description: This wary Pokémon uses photosynthesis to store up energy during the day, while becoming active at night.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Dartrix (3D)
pets.description: A bit of a dandy, it spends its free time preening its wings. Its preoccupation with any dirt on its plumage can leave it unable to battle.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Decidueye (3D)
pets.description: It fires arrow quills from its wings with such precision, they can pierce a pebble at distances over a hundred yards.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Litten (3D)
pets.description: While grooming itself, it builds up fur inside its stomach. It sets the fur alight and spews fiery attacks, which change based on how it coughs.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Torracat (3D)
pets.description: At its throat, it bears a bell of fire. The bell rings brightly whenever this Pokémon spits fire.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Incineroar (3D)
pets.description: This Pokémon has a violent, selfish disposition. If it’s not in the mood to listen, it will ignore its Trainer’s orders with complete nonchalance.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Popplio (3D)
pets.description: This Pokémon snorts body fluids from its nose, blowing balloons to smash into its foes. It’s famous for being a hard worker.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Brionne (3D)
pets.description: A skillful dancer, it creates a sequence of water balloons as it dances, and briskly bombards its enemies.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Primarina (3D)
pets.description: It controls its water balloons with song. The melody is learned from others of its kind and is passed down from one generation to the next.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Pikipek (3D)
pets.description: It can peck at a rate of 16 times a second to drill holes in trees. It uses the holes for food storage and for nesting.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Trumbeak (3D)
pets.description: It eats berries and stores their seeds in its beak. When it encounters enemies or prey, it fires off all the seeds in a burst.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Toucannon (3D)
pets.description: When it battles, its beak heats up. The temperature can easily exceed 212 degrees Fahrenheit, causing severe burns when it hits.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Yungoos (3D)
pets.description: With its sharp fangs, it will bite anything. It did not originally live in Alola but was imported from another region.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Gumshoos (3D)
pets.description: When it finds a trace of its prey, it patiently stakes out the location...but it’s always snoozing by nightfall.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Grubbin (3D)
pets.description: Its strong jaw enables it to scrape trees and slurp out the sap. It normally lives underground.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Charjabug (3D)
pets.description: Its body is capable of storing electricity. On camping trips, people are grateful to have one around.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Vikavolt (3D)
pets.description: It zips around, on sharp lookout for an opening. It concentrates electrical energy within its large jaws and uses it to zap its enemies.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Crabrawler (3D)
pets.description: While guarding its weak points with its pincers, it looks for an opening and unleashes punches. When it loses, it foams at the mouth and faints.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Crabominable (3D)
pets.description: It aimed for the top but got lost and ended up on a snowy mountain. Being forced to endure the cold, this Pokémon evolved and grew fur.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Oricorio (3D)
pets.description: It beats its wings together to create fire. As it moves in the steps of its beautiful dance, it bathes opponents in intense flames.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Cutiefly (3D)
pets.description: It feeds on the nectar and pollen of flowers. Because it’s able to sense auras, it can identify which flowers are about to bloom.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Ribombee (3D)
pets.description: It rolls up pollen into puffs. It makes many different varieties, some used as food and others used in battle.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Rockruff (3D)
pets.description: It’s considered to be a good Pokémon for beginners because of its friendliness, but its disposition grows rougher as it grows up.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Lycanroc (3D)
pets.description: Its quick movements confuse its enemies. Well equipped with claws and fangs, it also uses the sharp rocks in its mane as weapons.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Wishiwashi (3D)
pets.description: When it’s in trouble, its eyes moisten and begin to shine. The shining light attracts its comrades, and they stand together against their enemies.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Mareanie (3D)
pets.description: It plunges the poison spike on its head into its prey. When the prey has weakened, Mareanie deals the finishing blow with its 10 tentacles.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Toxapex (3D)
pets.description: Toxapex crawls along the ocean floor on its 12 legs. It leaves a trail of Corsola bits scattered in its wake.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Mudbray (3D)
pets.description: The mud stuck to Mudbray’s hooves enhances its grip and its powerful running gait.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Mudsdale (3D)
pets.description: It spits a mud that provides resistance to both wind and rain, so the walls of old houses were often coated with it.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Dewpider (3D)
pets.description: It crawls onto the land in search of food. Its water bubble allows it to breathe and protects its soft head.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Araquanid (3D)
pets.description: It delivers headbutts with the water bubble on its head. Small Pokémon get sucked into the bubble, where they drown.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Fomantis (3D)
pets.description: During the day, it sleeps and soaks up light. When night falls, it walks around looking for a safer place to sleep.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Lurantis (3D)
pets.description: It requires a lot of effort to maintain Lurantis’s vivid coloring, but some collectors enjoy this work and treat it as their hobby.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Morelull (3D)
pets.description: It scatters spores that flicker and glow. Anyone seeing these lights falls into a deep slumber.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Shiinotic (3D)
pets.description: Forests where Shiinotic live are treacherous to enter at night. People confused by its strange lights can never find their way home again.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Salandit (3D)
pets.description: It burns its bodily fluids to create a poisonous gas. When its enemies become disoriented from inhaling the gas, it attacks them.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Salazzle (3D)
pets.description: For some reason, only females have been found. It creates a reverse harem of male Salandit that it lives with.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Stufful (3D)
pets.description: Despite its adorable appearance, when it gets angry and flails about, its arms and legs could knock a pro wrestler sprawling.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Bewear (3D)
pets.description: This immensely dangerous Pokémon possesses overwhelming physical strength. Its habitat is generally off-limits.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Bounsweet (3D)
pets.description: A delectable aroma pours from its body. They are often swallowed whole by Toucannon lured by that wafting deliciousness.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Steenee (3D)
pets.description: The sepals on its head developed to protect its body. These are quite hard, so even if pecked by bird Pokémon, this Pokémon is totally fine.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Tsareena (3D)
pets.description: Its long, striking legs aren’t just for show but to be used to kick with skill. In victory, it shows off by kicking the defeated, laughing boisterously.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Comfey (3D)
pets.description: It attaches flowers to its highly nutritious vine. This revitalizes the flowers, and they give off an aromatic scent.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Oranguru (3D)
pets.description: Known for its extreme intelligence, this Pokémon will look down on inexperienced Trainers, so it’s best suited to veteran Trainers.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Passimian (3D)
pets.description: They form groups of roughly 20 individuals. Their mutual bond is remarkable—they will never let down a comrade.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Wimpod (3D)
pets.description: This Pokémon is a coward. As it desperately dashes off, the flailing of its many legs leaves a sparkling clean path in its wake.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Golisopod (3D)
pets.description: With a flashing slash of its giant sharp claws, it cleaves seawater—or even air—right in two.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Sandygast (3D)
pets.description: Born from a sand mound playfully built by a child, this Pokémon embodies the grudges of the departed.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Palossand (3D)
pets.description: Possessed people controlled by this Pokémon transformed its sand mound into a castle. As it evolved, its power to curse grew ever stronger.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Pyukumuku (3D)
pets.description: It’s covered in a slime that keeps its skin moist, allowing it to stay on land for days without drying up.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Type: Null (3D)
pets.description: The heavy control mask it wears suppresses its intrinsic capabilities. This Pokémon has some hidden special power.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Silvally (3D)
pets.description: Its trust in its partner is what awakens it. This Pokémon is capable of changing its type, a flexibility that is well displayed in battle.
