pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Minior (3D)
pets.description: Originally making its home in the ozone layer, it hurtles to the ground when the shell enclosing its body grows too heavy.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Komala (3D)
pets.description: It is born asleep, and it dies asleep. All its movements are apparently no more than the results of it tossing and turning in its dreams.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Turtonator (3D)
pets.description: The shell on its back is chemically unstable and explodes violently if struck. The hole in its stomach is its weak point.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Togedemaru (3D)
pets.description: The spiny fur on its back is normally at rest. When this Pokémon becomes agitated, its fur stands on end and stabs into its attackers.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Mimikyu (3D)
pets.description: Its actual appearance is unknown. A scholar who saw what was under its rag was overwhelmed by terror and died from the shock.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Bruxish (3D)
pets.description: When it unleashes its psychic power from the protuberance on its head, the grating sound of grinding teeth echoes through the area.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Drampa (3D)
pets.description: It has a compassionate personality, but if it is angered, it completely destroys its surroundings with its intense breath.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Dhelmise (3D)
pets.description: Swinging its massive anchor, it can KO Wailord in a single blow. What appears to be green seaweed is actually its body.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Jangmo-O (3D)
pets.description: It expresses its feelings by smacking its scales. Metallic sounds echo through the tall mountains where Jangmo-o lives.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Hakamo-O (3D)
pets.description: It leaps at its prey with a courageous shout. Its scaly punches tear its opponents to shreds.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Kommo-O (3D)
pets.description: When it spots enemies, it threatens them by jingling the scales on its tail. Weak opponents will crack and flee in panic.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Tapu Koko (3D)
pets.description: This guardian deity of Melemele is brimming with curiosity. It summons thunderclouds and stores their lightning inside its body.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Tapu Lele (3D)
pets.description: This guardian deity of Akala is guilelessly cruel. The fragrant aroma of flowers is the source of its energy.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Tapu Bulu (3D)
pets.description: It pulls large trees up by the roots and swings them around. It causes vegetation to grow, and then it absorbs energy from the growth.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Tapu Fini (3D)
pets.description: The dense fog it creates brings the downfall and destruction of its confused enemies. Ocean currents are the source of its energy.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Cosmog (3D)
pets.description: Its body is gaseous and frail. It slowly grows as it collects dust from the atmosphere.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Cosmoem (3D)
pets.description: Motionless as if dead, its body is faintly warm to the touch. In the distant past, it was called the cocoon of the stars.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Solgaleo (3D)
pets.description: It is said to live in another world. The intense light it radiates from the surface of its body can make the darkest of nights light up like midday.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Lunala (3D)
pets.description: It is said to be a female evolution of Cosmog. When its third eye activates, away it flies to another world.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Nihilego (3D)
pets.description: One of several mysterious Ultra Beasts. People on the street report observing those infested by it suddenly becoming violent.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Buzzwole (3D)
pets.description: This Ultra Beast appeared from another world. It shows off its body, but whether that display is a boast or a threat remains unclear.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Pheromosa (3D)
pets.description: One of the dangerous Ultra Beasts, it has been spotted running across the land at terrific speeds.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Xurkitree (3D)
pets.description: One of the mysterious life-forms known as Ultra Beasts. Astonishing electric shocks emanate from its entire body, according to witnesses.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Celesteela (3D)
pets.description: It appeared from the Ultra Wormhole. Witnesses observed it flying across the sky at high speed.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Kartana (3D)
pets.description: This Ultra Beast came from the Ultra Wormhole. It seems not to attack enemies on its own, but its sharp body is a dangerous weapon in itself.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Guzzlord (3D)
pets.description: It has gobbled mountains and swallowed whole buildings, according to reports. It’s one of the Ultra Beasts.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Necrozma (3D)
pets.description: Reminiscent of the Ultra Beasts, this life-form, apparently asleep underground, is thought to have come from another world in ancient times.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Magearna (3D)
pets.description: This artificial Pokémon, constructed more than 500 years ago, can understand human speech but cannot itself speak.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Marshadow (3D)
pets.description: Able to conceal itself in shadows, it never appears before humans, so its very existence was the stuff of myth.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Poipole (3D)
pets.description: This Ultra Beast is well enough liked to be chosen as a first partner in its own world.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Naganadel (3D)
pets.description: It stores hundreds of liters of poisonous liquid inside its body. It is one of the organisms known as UBs.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Stakataka (3D)
pets.description: It appeared from an Ultra Wormhole. Each one appears to be made up of many life-forms stacked one on top of each other.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Blacephalon (3D)
pets.description: It slithers toward people. Then, without warning, it triggers the explosion of its own head. It’s apparently one kind of Ultra Beast.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Zeraora (3D)
pets.description: It electrifies its claws and tears its opponents apart with them. Even if they dodge its attack, they’ll be electrocuted by the flying sparks.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Meltan (3D)
pets.description: It melts particles of iron and other metals found in the subsoil, so it can absorb them into its body of molten steel.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Melmetal (3D)
pets.description: Revered long ago for its capacity to create iron from nothing, for some reason it has come back to life after 3,000 years.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Grookey (3D)
pets.description: When it uses its special stick to strike up a beat, the sound waves produced carry revitalizing energy to the plants and flowers in the area.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Thwackey (3D)
pets.description: The faster a Thwackey can beat out a rhythm with its two sticks, the more respect it wins from its peers.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Rillaboom (3D)
pets.description: By drumming, it taps into the power of its special tree stump. The roots of the stump follow its direction in battle.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Scorbunny (3D)
pets.description: A warm-up of running around gets fire energy coursing through this Pokémon’s body. Once that happens, it’s ready to fight at full power.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Raboot (3D)
pets.description: Its thick and fluffy fur protects it from the cold and enables it to use hotter fire moves.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Cinderace (3D)
pets.description: It juggles a pebble with its feet, turning it into a burning soccer ball. Its shots strike opponents hard and leave them scorched.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Sobble (3D)
pets.description: When scared, this Pokémon cries. Its tears pack the chemical punch of 100 onions, and attackers won’t be able to resist weeping.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Drizzile (3D)
pets.description: A clever combatant, this Pokémon battles using water balloons created with moisture secreted from its palms.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Inteleon (3D)
pets.description: It has many hidden capabilities, such as fingertips that can shoot water and a membrane on its back that it can use to glide through the air.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Skwovet (3D)
pets.description: Found throughout the Galar region, this Pokémon becomes uneasy if its cheeks are ever completely empty of berries.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Greedent (3D)
pets.description: It stashes berries in its tail—so many berries that they fall out constantly. But this Pokémon is a bit slow-witted, so it doesn’t notice the loss.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Rookidee (3D)
pets.description: It will bravely challenge any opponent, no matter how powerful. This Pokémon benefits from every battle—even a defeat increases its strength a bit.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Corvisquire (3D)
pets.description: Smart enough to use tools in battle, these Pokémon have been seen picking up rocks and flinging them or using ropes to wrap up enemies.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Corviknight (3D)
pets.description: This Pokémon reigns supreme in the skies of the Galar region. The black luster of its steel body could drive terror into the heart of any foe.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Blipbug (3D)
pets.description: A constant collector of information, this Pokémon is very smart. Very strong is what it isn’t.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Dottler (3D)
pets.description: It barely moves, but it’s still alive. Hiding in its shell without food or water seems to have awakened its psychic powers.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Orbeetle (3D)
pets.description: It’s famous for its high level of intelligence, and the large size of its brain is proof that it also possesses immense psychic power.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Nickit (3D)
pets.description: Aided by the soft pads on its feet, it silently raids the food stores of other Pokémon. It survives off its ill-gotten gains.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Thievul (3D)
pets.description: It secretly marks potential targets with a scent. By following the scent, it stalks its targets and steals from them when they least expect it.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Gossifleur (3D)
pets.description: It anchors itself in the ground with its single leg, then basks in the sun. After absorbing enough sunlight, its petals spread as it blooms brilliantly.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Eldegoss (3D)
pets.description: The seeds attached to its cotton fluff are full of nutrients. It spreads them on the wind so that plants and other Pokémon can benefit from them.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Wooloo (3D)
pets.description: Its curly fleece is such an effective cushion that this Pokémon could fall off a cliff and stand right back up at the bottom, unharmed.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Dubwool (3D)
pets.description: Weave a carpet from its springy wool, and you end up with something closer to a trampoline. You’ll start to bounce the moment you set foot on it.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Chewtle (3D)
pets.description: Apparently the itch of its teething impels it to snap its jaws at anything in front of it.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Drednaw (3D)
pets.description: With jaws that can shear through steel rods, this highly aggressive Pokémon chomps down on its unfortunate prey.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Yamper (3D)
pets.description: This Pokémon is very popular as a herding dog in the Galar region. As it runs, it generates electricity from the base of its tail.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Boltund (3D)
pets.description: This Pokémon generates electricity and channels it into its legs to keep them going strong. Boltund can run nonstop for three full days.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Rolycoly (3D)
pets.description: Most of its body has the same composition as coal. Fittingly, this Pokémon was first discovered in coal mines about 400 years ago.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Carkol (3D)
pets.description: It forms coal inside its body. Coal dropped by this Pokémon once helped fuel the lives of people in the Galar region.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Coalossal (3D)
pets.description: It’s usually peaceful, but the vandalism of mines enrages it. Offenders will be incinerated with flames that reach 2,700 degrees Fahrenheit.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Applin (3D)
pets.description: It spends its entire life inside an apple. It hides from its natural enemies, bird Pokémon, by pretending it’s just an apple and nothing more.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Flapple (3D)
pets.description: It ate a sour apple, and that induced its evolution. In its cheeks, it stores an acid capable of causing chemical burns.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Appletun (3D)
pets.description: Eating a sweet apple caused its evolution. A nectarous scent wafts from its body, luring in the bug Pokémon it preys on.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Silicobra (3D)
pets.description: As it digs, it swallows sand and stores it in its neck pouch. The pouch can hold more than 17 pounds of sand.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Sandaconda (3D)
pets.description: When it contracts its body, over 220 pounds of sand sprays from its nose. If it ever runs out of sand, it becomes disheartened.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Cramorant (3D)
pets.description: It’s so strong that it can knock out some opponents in a single hit, but it also may forget what it’s battling midfight.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Arrokuda (3D)
pets.description: If it sees any movement around it, this Pokémon charges for it straightaway, leading with its sharply pointed jaw. It’s very proud of that jaw.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Barraskewda (3D)
pets.description: This Pokémon has a jaw that’s as sharp as a spear and as strong as steel. Apparently Barraskewda’s flesh is surprisingly tasty, too.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Toxel (3D)
pets.description: It stores poison in an internal poison sac and secretes that poison through its skin. If you touch this Pokémon, a tingling sensation follows.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Toxtricity (3D)
pets.description: When this Pokémon sounds as if it’s strumming a guitar, it’s actually clawing at the protrusions on its chest to generate electricity.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Sizzlipede (3D)
pets.description: It stores flammable gas in its body and uses it to generate heat. The yellow sections on its belly get particularly hot.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Centiskorch (3D)
pets.description: When it heats up, its body temperature reaches about 1,500 degrees Fahrenheit. It lashes its body like a whip and launches itself at enemies.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Clobbopus (3D)
pets.description: It’s very curious, but its means of investigating things is to try to punch them with its tentacles. The search for food is what brings it onto land.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Grapploct (3D)
pets.description: A body made up of nothing but muscle makes the grappling moves this Pokémon performs with its tentacles tremendously powerful.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Sinistea (3D)
pets.description: This Pokémon is said to have been born when a lonely spirit possessed a cold, leftover cup of tea.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Polteageist (3D)
pets.description: This species lives in antique teapots. Most pots are forgeries, but on rare occasions, an authentic work is found.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Hatenna (3D)
pets.description: Via the protrusion on its head, it senses other creatures’ emotions. If you don’t have a calm disposition, it will never warm up to you.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Hattrem (3D)
pets.description: No matter who you are, if you bring strong emotions near this Pokémon, it will silence you violently.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Hatterene (3D)
pets.description: It emits psychic power strong enough to cause headaches as a deterrent to the approach of others.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Impidimp (3D)
pets.description: Through its nose, it sucks in the emanations produced by people and Pokémon when they feel annoyed. It thrives off this negative energy.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Morgrem (3D)
pets.description: When it gets down on all fours as if to beg for forgiveness, it’s trying to lure opponents in so that it can stab them with its spear-like hair.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Grimmsnarl (3D)
pets.description: With the hair wrapped around its body helping to enhance its muscles, this Pokémon can overwhelm even Machamp.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Obstagoon (3D)
pets.description: Its voice is staggering in volume. Obstagoon has a tendency to take on a threatening posture and shout—this move is known as Obstruct.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Perrserker (3D)
pets.description: What appears to be an iron helmet is actually hardened hair. This Pokémon lives for the thrill of battle.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Cursola (3D)
pets.description: Its shell is overflowing with its heightened otherworldly energy. The ectoplasm serves as protection for this Pokémon’s core spirit.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Sirfetchd (3D)
pets.description: Only Farfetch’d that have survived many battles can attain this evolution. When this Pokémon’s leek withers, it will retire from combat.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Mr. Rime (3D)
pets.description: It’s highly skilled at tap-dancing. It waves its cane of ice in time with its graceful movements.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Runerigus (3D)
pets.description: A powerful curse was woven into an ancient painting. After absorbing the spirit of a Yamask, the painting began to move.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Milcery (3D)
pets.description: This Pokémon was born from sweet-smelling particles in the air. Its body is made of cream.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Alcremie (3D)
pets.description: When it trusts a Trainer, it will treat them to berries it’s decorated with cream.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Falinks (3D)
pets.description: Five of them are troopers, and one is the brass. The brass’s orders are absolute.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Pincurchin (3D)
pets.description: It feeds on seaweed, using its teeth to scrape it off rocks. Electric current flows from the tips of its spines.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Snom (3D)
pets.description: It spits out thread imbued with a frigid sort of energy and uses it to tie its body to branches, disguising itself as an icicle while it sleeps.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Frosmoth (3D)
pets.description: Icy scales fall from its wings like snow as it flies over fields and mountains. The temperature of its wings is less than −290 degrees Fahrenheit.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Stonjourner (3D)
pets.description: It stands in grasslands, watching the sun’s descent from zenith to horizon. This Pokémon has a talent for delivering dynamic kicks.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Eiscue (3D)
pets.description: It drifted in on the flow of ocean waters from a frigid place. It keeps its head iced constantly to make sure it stays nice and cold.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Indeedee (3D)
pets.description: It uses the horns on its head to sense the emotions of others. Males will act as valets for those they serve, looking after their every need.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Morpeko (3D)
pets.description: As it eats the seeds stored up in its pocket-like pouches, this Pokémon is not just satisfying its constant hunger. It’s also generating electricity.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Cufant (3D)
pets.description: It digs up the ground with its trunk. It’s also very strong, being able to carry loads of over five tons without any problem at all.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Copperajah (3D)
pets.description: They came over from another region long ago and worked together with humans. Their green skin is resistant to water.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Dracozolt (3D)
pets.description: In ancient times, it was unbeatable thanks to its powerful lower body, but it went extinct anyway after it depleted all its plant-based food sources.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Arctozolt (3D)
pets.description: The shaking of its freezing upper half is what generates its electricity. It has a hard time walking around.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Dracovish (3D)
pets.description: Powerful legs and jaws made it the apex predator of its time. Its own overhunting of its prey was what drove it to extinction.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Arctovish (3D)
pets.description: Though it’s able to capture prey by freezing its surroundings, it has trouble eating the prey afterward because its mouth is on top of its head.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Duraludon (3D)
pets.description: Its body resembles polished metal, and it’s both lightweight and strong. The only drawback is that it rusts easily.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Dreepy (3D)
pets.description: After being reborn as a ghost Pokémon, Dreepy wanders the areas it used to inhabit back when it was alive in prehistoric seas.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Drakloak (3D)
pets.description: It’s capable of flying faster than 120 mph. It battles alongside Dreepy and dotes on them until they successfully evolve.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Dragapult (3D)
pets.description: When it isn’t battling, it keeps Dreepy in the holes on its horns. Once a fight starts, it launches the Dreepy like supersonic missiles.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Zacian (3D)
pets.description: Known as a legendary hero, this Pokémon absorbs metal particles, transforming them into a weapon it uses to battle.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Zamazenta (3D)
pets.description: In times past, it worked together with a king of the people to save the Galar region. It absorbs metal that it then uses in battle.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Eternatus (3D)
pets.description: The core on its chest absorbs energy emanating from the lands of the Galar region. This energy is what allows Eternatus to stay active.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Kubfu (3D)
pets.description: Kubfu trains hard to perfect its moves. The moves it masters will determine which form it takes when it evolves.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Urshifu (3D)
pets.description: This form of Urshifu is a strong believer in the one-hit KO. Its strategy is to leap in close to foes and land a devastating blow with a hardened fist.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Zarude (3D)
pets.description: Within dense forests, this Pokémon lives in a pack with others of its kind. It’s incredibly aggressive, and the other Pokémon of the forest fear it.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Regieleki (3D)
pets.description: This Pokémon is a cluster of electrical energy. It’s said that removing the rings on Regieleki’s body will unleash the Pokémon’s latent power.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Regidrago (3D)
pets.description: An academic theory proposes that Regidrago’s arms were once the head of an ancient dragon Pokémon. The theory remains unproven.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Glastrier (3D)
pets.description: Glastrier emits intense cold from its hooves. It’s also a belligerent Pokémon—anything it wants, it takes by force.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Spectrier (3D)
pets.description: It probes its surroundings with all its senses save one—it doesn’t use its sense of sight. Spectrier’s kicks are said to separate soul from body.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Calyrex (3D)
pets.description: Calyrex is a merciful Pokémon, capable of providing healing and blessings. It reigned over the Galar region in times of yore.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Wyrdeer (3D)
pets.description: The black orbs shine with an uncanny light when the Pokémon is erecting invisible barriers.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Kleavor (3D)
pets.description: A violent creature that fells towering trees with its crude axes and shields itself with hard stone.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Ursaluna (3D)
pets.description: I believe it was Hisui's swampy terrain that gave Ursaluna its burly physique and newfound capacity to manipulate peat at will.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Basculegion (3D)
pets.description: Clads itself in the souls of comrades that perished before fulfilling their goals of journeying upstream.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Sneasler (3D)
pets.description: Because of Sneasler's virulent poison and daunting physical prowess, no other species could hope to best it on the frozen highlands.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Overqwil (3D)
pets.description: Its lancelike spikes and savage temperament have earned it the nickname ”sea fiend.” It slurps up poison to nourish itself.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Enamorus (3D)
pets.description: When it flies to this land from across the sea, the bitter winter comes to an end.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Sprigatito (3D)
pets.description: Its fluffy fur is similar in composition to plants. This Pokémon frequently washes its face to keep it from drying out.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Floragato (3D)
pets.description: Floragato deftly wields the vine hidden beneath its long fur, slamming the hard flower bud against its opponents.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Meowscarada (3D)
pets.description: This Pokémon uses the reflective fur lining its cape to camouflage the stem of its flower, creating the illusion that the flower is floating.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Fuecoco (3D)
pets.description: It lies on warm rocks and uses the heat absorbed by its square-shaped scales to create fire energy.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Crocalor (3D)
pets.description: The combination of Crocalor’s fire energy and overflowing vitality has caused an egg-shaped fireball to appear on the Pokémon’s head.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Skeledirge (3D)
pets.description: The fiery bird changes shape when Skeledirge sings. Rumor has it that the bird was born when the fireball on Skeledirge’s head gained a soul.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Quaxly (3D)
pets.description: This Pokémon migrated to Paldea from distant lands long ago. The gel secreted by its feathers repels water and grime.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Quaxwell (3D)
pets.description: These Pokémon constantly run through shallow waters to train their legs, then compete with each other to see which of them kicks most gracefully.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Quaquaval (3D)
pets.description: A single kick from a Quaquaval can send a truck rolling. This Pokémon uses its powerful legs to perform striking dances from far-off lands.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Lechonk (3D)
pets.description: It searches for food all day. It possesses a keen sense of smell but doesn’t use it for anything other than foraging.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Oinkologne (3D)
pets.description: Oinkologne is proud of its fine, glossy skin. It emits a concentrated scent from the tip of its tail.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Tarountula (3D)
pets.description: The ball of threads wrapped around its body is elastic enough to deflect the scythes of Scyther, this Pokémon’s natural enemy.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Spidops (3D)
pets.description: It clings to branches and ceilings using its threads and moves without a sound. It takes out its prey before the prey even notices it.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Nymble (3D)
pets.description: It has its third set of legs folded up. When it’s in a tough spot, this Pokémon jumps over 30 feet using the strength of its legs.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Lokix (3D)
pets.description: When it decides to fight all out, it stands on its previously folded legs to enter Showdown Mode. It neutralizes its enemies in short order.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Pawmi (3D)
pets.description: It has underdeveloped electric sacs on its cheeks. These sacs can produce electricity only if Pawmi rubs them furiously with the pads on its forepaws.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Pawmo (3D)
pets.description: When its group is attacked, Pawmo is the first to leap into battle, defeating enemies with a fighting technique that utilizes electric shocks.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Pawmot (3D)
pets.description: This Pokémon normally is slow to react, but once it enters battle, it will strike down its enemies with lightning-fast movements.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Tandemaus (3D)
pets.description: Exhibiting great teamwork, they use their incisors to cut pieces out of any material that might be useful for a nest, then make off with them.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Maushold (3D)
pets.description: The two little ones just appeared one day. The group might be a family of related Pokémon, but nobody knows for sure.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Fidough (3D)
pets.description: This Pokémon is smooth and moist to the touch. Yeast in Fidough’s breath induces fermentation in the Pokémon’s vicinity.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Dachsbun (3D)
pets.description: The pleasant aroma that emanates from this Pokémon’s body helps wheat grow, so Dachsbun has been treasured by farming villages.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Smoliv (3D)
pets.description: It protects itself from enemies by emitting oil from the fruit on its head. This oil is bitter and astringent enough to make someone flinch.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Dolliv (3D)
pets.description: Dolliv shares its tasty, fresh-scented oil with others. This species has coexisted with humans since times long gone.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Arboliva (3D)
pets.description: This calm Pokémon is very compassionate. It will share its delicious, nutrient-rich oil with weakened Pokémon.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Squawkabilly (3D)
pets.description: These Pokémon prefer to live in cities. They form flocks based on the color of their feathers, and they fight over territory.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Nacli (3D)
pets.description: It was born in a layer of rock salt deep under the earth. This species was particularly treasured in the old days, as they would share precious salt.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Naclstack (3D)
pets.description: This Pokémon dry cures its prey by spraying salt over them. The curing process steals away the water in the prey’s body.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Garganacl (3D)
pets.description: Garganacl will rub its fingertips together and sprinkle injured Pokémon with salt. Even severe wounds will promptly heal afterward.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Charcadet (3D)
pets.description: Burnt charcoal came to life and became a Pokémon. Possessing a fiery fighting spirit, Charcadet will battle even tough opponents.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Armarouge (3D)
pets.description: Armarouge evolved through the use of a set of armor that belonged to a distinguished warrior. This Pokémon is incredibly loyal.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Ceruledge (3D)
pets.description: The fiery blades on its arms burn fiercely with the lingering resentment of a sword wielder who fell before accomplishing their goal.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Tadbulb (3D)
pets.description: Tadbulb shakes its tail to generate electricity. If it senses danger, it will make its head blink on and off to alert its allies.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Bellibolt (3D)
pets.description: When this Pokémon expands and contracts its wobbly body, the belly-button dynamo in its stomach produces a huge amount of electricity.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Wattrel (3D)
pets.description: When its wings catch the wind, the bones within produce electricity. This Pokémon dives into the ocean, catching prey by electrocuting them.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Kilowattrel (3D)
pets.description: Kilowattrel inflates its throat sac to amplify its electricity. By riding the wind, this Pokémon can fly over 430 miles in a day.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Maschiff (3D)
pets.description: It always scowls in an attempt to make opponents take it seriously, but even crying children will burst into laughter when they see Maschiff’s face.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Mabosstiff (3D)
pets.description: This Pokémon can store energy in its large dewlap. Mabosstiff unleashes this energy all at once to blow away enemies.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Shroodle (3D)
pets.description: Though usually a mellow Pokémon, it will sink its sharp, poison-soaked front teeth into any that anger it, causing paralysis in the object of its ire.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Grafaiai (3D)
pets.description: The color of the poisonous saliva depends on what the Pokémon eats. Grafaiai covers its fingers in its saliva and draws patterns on trees in forests.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Bramblin (3D)
pets.description: A soul unable to move on to the afterlife was blown around by the wind until it got tangled up with dried grass and became a Pokémon.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Brambleghast (3D)
pets.description: It will open the branches of its head to envelop its prey. Once it absorbs all the life energy it needs, it expels the prey and discards it.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Toedscool (3D)
pets.description: Toedscool lives in muggy forests. The flaps that fall from its body are chewy and very delicious.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Toedscruel (3D)
pets.description: These Pokémon gather into groups and form colonies deep within forests. They absolutely hate it when strangers approach.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Klawf (3D)
pets.description: Klawf hangs upside-down from cliffs, waiting for prey. But Klawf can’t remain in this position for long because its blood rushes to its head.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Capsakid (3D)
pets.description: The more sunlight this Pokémon bathes in, the more spicy chemicals are produced by its body, and thus the spicier its moves become.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Scovillain (3D)
pets.description: The red head converts spicy chemicals into fire energy and blasts the surrounding area with a super spicy stream of flame.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Rellor (3D)
pets.description: This Pokémon creates a mud ball by mixing sand and dirt with psychic energy. It treasures its mud ball more than its own life.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Rabsca (3D)
pets.description: The body that supports the ball barely moves. Therefore, it is thought that the true body of this Pokémon is actually inside the ball.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Flittle (3D)
pets.description: Flittle’s toes levitate about half an inch above the ground because of the psychic power emitted from the frills on the Pokémon’s belly.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Espathra (3D)
pets.description: It immobilizes opponents by bathing them in psychic power from its large eyes. Despite its appearance, it has a vicious temperament.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Tinkatink (3D)
pets.description: It swings its handmade hammer around to protect itself, but the hammer is often stolen by Pokémon that eat metal.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Tinkatuff (3D)
pets.description: This Pokémon will attack groups of Pawniard and Bisharp, gathering metal from them in order to create a large and sturdy hammer.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Tinkaton (3D)
pets.description: This intelligent Pokémon has a very daring disposition. It knocks rocks into the sky with its hammer, aiming for flying Corviknight.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Wiglett (3D)
pets.description: This Pokémon can pick up the scent of a Veluza just over 65 feet away and will hide itself in the sand.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Wugtrio (3D)
pets.description: It has a vicious temperament, contrary to what its appearance may suggest. It wraps its long bodies around prey, then drags the prey into its den.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Bombirdier (3D)
pets.description: It gathers things up in an apron made from shed feathers added to the Pokémon’s chest feathers, then drops those things from high places for fun.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Finizen (3D)
pets.description: It likes playing with others of its kind using the water ring on its tail. It uses ultrasonic waves to sense the emotions of other living creatures.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Palafin (3D)
pets.description: This Pokémon changes its appearance if it hears its allies calling for help. Palafin will never show anybody its moment of transformation.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Varoom (3D)
pets.description: It is said that this Pokémon was born when an unknown poison Pokémon entered and inspirited an engine left at a scrap-processing factory.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Revavroom (3D)
pets.description: It creates a gas out of poison and minerals from rocks. It then detonates the gas in its cylinders—now numbering eight—to generate energy.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Cyclizar (3D)
pets.description: Apparently Cyclizar has been allowing people to ride on its back since ancient times. Depictions of this have been found in 10,000-year-old murals.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Orthworm (3D)
pets.description: When attacked, this Pokémon will wield the tendrils on its body like fists and pelt the opponent with a storm of punches.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Glimmet (3D)
pets.description: It absorbs nutrients from cave walls. The petals it wears are made of crystallized poison.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Glimmora (3D)
pets.description: When this Pokémon detects danger, it will open up its crystalline petals and fire beams from its conical body.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Greavard (3D)
pets.description: It is said that a dog Pokémon that died in the wild without ever interacting with a human was reborn as this Pokémon.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Houndstone (3D)
pets.description: Houndstone spends most of its time sleeping in graveyards. Among all the dog Pokémon, this one is most loyal to its master.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Flamigo (3D)
pets.description: This Pokémon apparently ties the base of its neck into a knot so that energy stored in its belly does not escape from its beak.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Cetoddle (3D)
pets.description: This species left the ocean and began living on land a very long time ago. It seems to be closely related to Wailmer.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Cetitan (3D)
pets.description: This Pokémon wanders around snowy, icy areas. It protects its body with powerful muscles and a thick layer of fat under its skin.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Veluza (3D)
pets.description: When Veluza discards unnecessary flesh, its mind becomes honed and its psychic power increases. The spare flesh has a mild but delicious flavor.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Dondozo (3D)
pets.description: This Pokémon is a glutton, but it’s bad at getting food. It teams up with a Tatsugiri to catch prey.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Tatsugiri (3D)
pets.description: This is a small dragon Pokémon. It lives inside the mouth of Dondozo to protect itself from enemies on the outside.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Annihilape (3D)
pets.description: When its anger rose beyond a critical point, this Pokémon gained power that is unfettered by the limits of its physical body.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Clodsire (3D)
pets.description: When attacked, this Pokémon will retaliate by sticking thick spines out from its body. It’s a risky move that puts everything on the line.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Farigiraf (3D)
pets.description: Now that the brain waves from the head and tail are synced up, the psychic power of this Pokémon is 10 times stronger than Girafarig’s.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Dudunsparce (3D)
pets.description: This Pokémon uses its hard tail to make its nest by boring holes into bedrock deep underground. The nest can reach lengths of over six miles.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Kingambit (3D)
pets.description: Only a Bisharp that stands above all others in its vast army can evolve into Kingambit.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Great Tusk (3D)
pets.description: Sightings of this Pokémon have occurred in recent years. The name Great Tusk was taken from a creature listed in a certain book.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Scream Tail (3D)
pets.description: There has been only one reported sighting of this Pokémon. It resembles a mysterious creature depicted in an old expedition journal.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Brute Bonnet (3D)
pets.description: It is possible that the creature listed as Brute Bonnet in a certain book could actually be this Pokémon.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Flutter Mane (3D)
pets.description: This Pokémon has characteristics similar to those of Flutter Mane, a creature mentioned in a certain book.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Slither Wing (3D)
pets.description: This mysterious Pokémon has some similarities to a creature that an old book introduced as Slither Wing.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Sandy Shocks (3D)
pets.description: No records exist of this Pokémon being caught. Data is lacking, but the Pokémon’s traits match up with a creature shown in an expedition journal.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Frigibax (3D)
pets.description: Frigibax absorbs heat through its dorsal fin and converts the heat into ice energy. The higher the temperature, the more energy Frigibax stores.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Arctibax (3D)
pets.description: Arctibax freezes the air around it, protecting its face with an ice mask and turning its dorsal fin into a blade of ice.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Baxcalibur (3D)
pets.description: This Pokémon blasts cryogenic air out from its mouth. This air can instantly freeze even liquid-hot lava.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Gimmighoul (3D)
pets.description: This Pokémon was born inside a treasure chest about 1,500 years ago. It sucks the life-force out of scoundrels who try to steal the treasure.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Gholdengo (3D)
pets.description: Its body seems to be made up of 1,000 coins. This Pokémon gets along well with others and is quick to make friends with anybody.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Roaring Moon (3D)
pets.description: It is possible that this is the creature listed as Roaring Moon in an expedition journal that still holds many mysteries.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Koraidon (3D)
pets.description: This seems to be the Winged King mentioned in an old expedition journal. It was said to have split the land with its bare fists.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Walking Wake (3D)
pets.description: This ferocious creature is shrouded in mystery. It's named after an aquatic monster mentioned in an old expedition journal.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Dipplin (3D)
pets.description: Dipplin is two creatures in one Pokémon. Its evolution was triggered by a special apple grown only in one place.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Poltchageist (3D)
pets.description: Supposedly, the regrets of a tea ceremony master who died before perfecting his craft lingered in some matcha and became a Pokémon.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Sinistcha (3D)
pets.description: It pretends to be tea, trying to fool people into drinking it so it can drain their life-force. Its ruse is generally unsuccessful.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Archaludon (3D)
pets.description: It gathers static electricity from its surroundings. The beams it launches when down on all fours are tremendously powerful.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Hydrapple (3D)
pets.description: Seven syrpents live inside an apple made of syrup. The syrpent in the center is the commander.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Gouging Fire (3D)
pets.description: There are scant few reports of this creature being sighted. One short video shows it rampaging and spouting pillars of flame.
pets.author: codex-pokepets

pets.name: Raging Bolt (3D)
pets.description: It's said to incinerate everything around it with lightning launched from its fur. Very little is known about this creature.
pets.author: codex-pokepets
